passages.original: And now and then an ample tear trill’d down Her delicate cheek.
passages.vernacular: 時不時一顆大淚珠滾下佢嬌嫩嘅臉頰。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 時不時一顆大淚珠滾下她嬌嫩的臉頰。

passages.original: It seem’d she was a queen Over her passion; who, most rebel-like, Sought to be king o’er her.
passages.vernacular: 佢似乎係自己激情嘅王后;嗰激情最像叛徒,企圖做佢嘅國王。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她似乎是自己激情的王后;那激情最像叛徒,企圖做她的國王。

passages.title: Kent 肯特
passages.original: O, then it mov’d her.
passages.vernacular: 啊,咁呢打動咗佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,那麼這打動了她。

passages.title: Gentleman 紳士
passages.original: Not to a rage: patience and sorrow strove Who should express her goodliest.
passages.vernacular: 冇到憤怒:耐心同悲傷喺爭住邊個能表現得最美。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 沒有到憤怒:耐心與悲傷在爭著誰能表現得最美。

passages.original: You have seen Sunshine and rain at once: her smiles and tears Were like a better day.
passages.vernacular: 你見過陽光同雨同時出現:佢嘅微笑同眼淚像一個更好嘅日子。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你見過陽光與雨同時出現:她的微笑與眼淚像一個更好的日子。

passages.original: Those happy smilets That play’d on her ripe lip seem’d not to know What guests were in her eyes;
passages.vernacular: 嗰啲喺佢成熟嘴唇上遊戲嘅幸福小微笑,似乎唔知道佢眼中有乜嘢客人;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那些在她成熟嘴唇上遊戲的幸福小微笑,似乎不知道她眼中有什麼客人;

passages.original: which parted thence As pearls from diamonds dropp’d.
passages.vernacular: 嗰啲眼淚從嗰度落下,像珍珠從鑽石上滴落。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那些眼淚從那裡落下,像珍珠從鑽石上滴落。

passages.original: In brief, Sorrow would be a rarity most belov’d, If all could so become it.
passages.vernacular: 簡言之,如果所有人都能咁樣穿戴悲傷,悲傷就會成為最受愛戴嘅稀有物。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 簡言之,如果所有人都能這樣穿戴悲傷,悲傷就會成為最受愛戴的稀有物。

passages.title: Kent 肯特
passages.original: Made she no verbal question?
passages.vernacular: 佢冇講過話嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她沒有說過話嗎?

passages.title: Gentleman 紳士
passages.original: Faith, once or twice she heav’d the name of ‘father’ Pantingly forth, as if it press’d her heart; Cried ‘Sisters, sisters!
passages.vernacular: 講真嘅,佢一兩次喘住氣吐出「父親」呢個名字,好像佢壓住佢嘅心;喊「姊姊哋,姊姊哋!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 說真的,她一兩次喘著氣吐出「父親」這個名字,好像它壓著她的心;喊「姊姊們,姊姊們!

passages.original: Shame of ladies! sisters! Kent! father! sisters!
passages.vernacular: 女人嘅恥辱!姊姊哋!肯特!父親!姊姊哋!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 女人的恥辱!姊姊們!肯特!父親!姊姊們!

passages.original: What, i’ the storm?
passages.vernacular: 乜嘢,喺風暴中?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼,在風暴中?

passages.original: i’ the night?
passages.vernacular: 喺夜裡?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 在夜裡?

passages.original: Let pity not be believ’d!’
passages.vernacular: 唔好畀人相信憐憫!」
passages.vernacularMandarin: 別讓人相信憐憫!」

passages.original: There she shook The holy water from her heavenly eyes, And clamour master’d her:
passages.vernacular: 佢就咁樣從佢天使般嘅眼睛裡抖落聖水,哀號壓倒咗佢:
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她就這樣從她天使般的眼睛裡抖落聖水,哀號壓倒了她:

passages.original: then away she started To deal with grief alone.
passages.vernacular: 然後佢走開,獨自同悲傷相處。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 然後她走開,獨自與悲傷相處。

passages.title: Kent 肯特
passages.original: It is the stars, The stars above us govern our conditions;
passages.vernacular: 係星辰,我哋頭上嘅星辰支配我哋嘅境況;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是星辰,我們頭上的星辰支配我們的境況;

passages.original: Else one self mate and make could not beget Such different issues.
passages.vernacular: 否則同一對配偶唔可能生出咁不同嘅細路。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 否則同一對配偶不可能生出這麼不同的孩子。

passages.original: You spoke not with her since?
passages.vernacular: 你之後冇同佢講過話嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你之後沒有和她說過話嗎?

passages.title: Gentleman 紳士
passages.original: No.
passages.vernacular: 冇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 沒有。

passages.title: Kent 肯特
passages.original: Was this before the King return’d?
passages.vernacular: 呢個係喺國王回國之前嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是在國王回國之前嗎?

passages.title: Gentleman 紳士
passages.original: No, since.
passages.vernacular: 不,係之後。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,是之後。

passages.title: Kent 肯特
passages.original: Well, sir, the poor distressed Lear’s i’ the town;
passages.vernacular: 好,先生,可憐受難嘅李爾喺城裡;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好,先生,可憐受難的李爾在城裡;

passages.original: Who sometime, in his better tune, remembers What we are come about, and by no means Will yield to see his daughter.
passages.vernacular: 佢有時喺比較好嘅狀態下記得我哋為何而嚟,無論如何唔肯同意見佢嘅女兒。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他有時在比較好的狀態下記得我們為何而來,無論如何不肯同意見他的女兒。

passages.title: Gentleman 紳士
passages.original: Why, good sir?
passages.vernacular: 點解,好先生?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 為什麼,好先生?

passages.title: Kent 肯特
passages.original: A sovereign shame so elbows him.
passages.vernacular: 一種至高嘅羞恥推擠住佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 一種至高的羞恥推擠著他。

passages.original: His own unkindness, That stripp’d her from his benediction, turn’d her To foreign casualties, gave her dear rights To his dog-hearted daughters, these things sting His mind so venomously that burning shame Detains him from Cordelia.
passages.vernacular: 佢自己嘅不仁慈——剝奪咗佢嘅祝福,把佢轉畀外邦嘅偶然,把佢珍貴嘅權利畀咗佢嗰啲狗心嘅女兒——呢啲事如此毒辣地刺痛佢嘅心,燃燒嘅羞恥使佢不去見考黛莉亞。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他自己的不仁慈——剝奪了她的祝福,把她轉給外邦的偶然,把她珍貴的權利給了他那些狗心的女兒——這些事如此毒辣地刺痛他的心,燃燒的羞恥使他不去見考黛莉亞。

passages.title: Gentleman 紳士
passages.original: Alack, poor gentleman!
passages.vernacular: 哎呀,可憐嘅先生!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎呀,可憐的先生!

passages.title: Kent 肯特
passages.original: Of Albany’s and Cornwall’s powers you heard not?
passages.vernacular: 奧本尼同康華爾嘅軍隊,你冇聽講嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 奧本尼和康華爾的軍隊,你沒聽說嗎?

passages.title: Gentleman 紳士
passages.original: ’Tis so; they are afoot.
passages.vernacular: 係嘅,佢哋出動喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是的,他們出動了。

passages.title: Kent 肯特
passages.original: Well, sir, I’ll bring you to our master Lear And leave you to attend him.
passages.vernacular: 好,先生,我帶你去見我哋嘅主人李爾,然後留你侍候佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好,先生,我帶你去見我們的主人李爾,然後留你侍候他。

passages.original: Some dear cause Will in concealment wrap me up awhile;
passages.vernacular: 某種重大原因會把我暫時隱藏起嚟;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 某種重大原因會把我暫時隱藏起來;

passages.original: When I am known aright, you shall not grieve Lending me this acquaintance.
passages.vernacular: 當我被如實認出時,你借此同我結識唔會後悔。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 當我被如實認出時,你借此與我結識不會後悔。

passages.original: I pray you, go along with me.
passages.vernacular: 請你,跟我嚟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 請你,跟我來。

passages.original: [Exeunt.]
passages.vernacular: [同下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [同下。]

chapters.title: Act IV, Scene IV — The French Camp, a Tent 第四幕第四場:法軍營帳

passages.original: Enter with drum and colours, Cordelia, Physician and Soldiers.
passages.vernacular: [考黛莉亞、醫生同士兵哋帶鼓同旗幟上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [考黛莉亞、醫生和士兵們帶鼓和旗幟上。]

passages.title: Cordelia 考黛莉亞
passages.original: Alack, ’tis he: why, he was met even now As mad as the vex’d sea;
passages.vernacular: 哎呀,係佢:睇,佢頭先被人遇見,瘋得像被擾動嘅海;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎呀,是他:看,他剛才被人遇見,瘋得像被擾動的海;

passages.original: singing aloud; Crown’d with rank fumiter and furrow weeds, With harlocks, hemlock, nettles, cuckoo-flowers, Darnel, and all the idle weeds that grow In our sustaining corn.
passages.vernacular: 大聲唱歌;戴住野生嘅紫堇同田壟雜草做嘅冠,有田芥、毒芹、蕁麻、布穀鳥花、毒麥,以及一切生長喺我哋養人嘅麥子裡嘅無用雜草。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 大聲唱歌;戴著野生的紫堇和田壟雜草做的冠,有田芥、毒芹、蕁麻、布穀鳥花、毒麥,以及一切生長在我們養人的麥子裡的無用雜草。

passages.original: A century send forth; Search every acre in the high-grown field, And bring him to our eye.
passages.vernacular: 派一百人出去;搜索高長嘅田野每一畝,把佢帶到我哋眼前。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 派一百人出去;搜索高長的田野每一畝,把他帶到我們眼前。

passages.original: [Exit an Officer.]
passages.vernacular: [一名軍官下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [一名軍官下。]

passages.title: Cordelia 考黛莉亞
passages.original: What can man’s wisdom In the restoring his bereaved sense, He that helps him take all my outward worth.
passages.vernacular: 人嘅智慧能做乜嘢嚟恢復佢失去嘅神志?能幫助佢嘅人,攞走我所有外喺嘅價值。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 人的智慧能做什麼來恢復他失去的神志?能幫助他的人,拿走我所有外在的價值。

passages.title: Physician 醫生
passages.original: There is means, madam: Our foster nurse of nature is repose, The which he lacks;
passages.vernacular: 有辦法,夫人:自然嘅養母係休息,佢缺少呢個;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 有辦法,夫人:自然的養母是休息,他缺少這個;

passages.original: that to provoke in him Are many simples operative, whose power Will close the eye of anguish.
passages.vernacular: 要促成佢休息,有許多有效嘅草藥,其力量會闔上痛苦嘅眼睛。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 要促成他休息,有許多有效的草藥,其力量會闔上痛苦的眼睛。

passages.title: Cordelia 考黛莉亞
passages.original: All bless’d secrets, All you unpublish’d virtues of the earth, Spring with my tears!
passages.vernacular: 所有蒙福嘅祕密,你哋所有未公開嘅大地之德,隨我嘅眼淚湧出吧!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 所有蒙福的祕密,你們所有未公開的大地之德,隨我的眼淚湧出吧!

passages.original: Be aidant and remediate In the good man’s distress!
passages.vernacular: 喺呢好人嘅苦難中幫助並補救!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 在這好人的苦難中幫助並補救!

passages.original: Seek, seek for him; Lest his ungovern’d rage dissolve the life That wants the means to lead it.
passages.vernacular: 找,找佢;免得佢不受控制嘅狂怒毀掉缺乏引導嘅生命。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 找,找他;免得他不受控制的狂怒毀掉缺乏引導的生命。

passages.original: Enter a Messenger.
passages.vernacular: [一位信使上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [一位信使上。]

passages.title: Messenger 信使
passages.original: News, madam; The British powers are marching hitherward.
passages.vernacular: 消息,夫人;不列顛軍隊正向呢邊進軍。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 消息,夫人;不列顛軍隊正向這邊進軍。

passages.title: Cordelia 考黛莉亞
passages.original: ’Tis known before.
passages.vernacular: 早就知道喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 早就知道了。

passages.original: Our preparation stands In expectation of them.
passages.vernacular: 我哋嘅準備正等住佢哋。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們的準備正等著他們。

passages.original: O dear father, It is thy business that I go about;
passages.vernacular: 啊親愛嘅父親,我正是為你嘅事奔忙;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊親愛的父親,我正是為你的事奔忙;

passages.original: Therefore great France My mourning and important tears hath pitied.
passages.vernacular: 所以偉大嘅法蘭西憐憫咗我嘅哀哭同迫切嘅眼淚。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 所以偉大的法蘭西憐憫了我的哀哭和迫切的眼淚。

passages.original: No blown ambition doth our arms incite, But love, dear love, and our ag’d father’s right:
passages.vernacular: 冇膨脹嘅野心煽動我哋嘅武器,只有愛,親愛嘅愛,同我哋年老父親嘅權利:
passages.vernacularMandarin: 沒有膨脹的野心煽動我們的武器,只有愛,親愛的愛,和我們年老父親的權利:

passages.original: Soon may I hear and see him!
passages.vernacular: 但願我好快聽到並睇到佢!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但願我很快聽到並看到他!

passages.original: [Exeunt.]
passages.vernacular: [同下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [同下。]

chapters.title: Act IV, Scene V — A Room in Gloucester’s Castle 第四幕第五場:葛羅斯特城堡一室

passages.original: Enter Regan and Oswald.
passages.vernacular: [里根同奧斯華上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [里根和奧斯華上。]

passages.title: Regan 里根
passages.original: But are my brother’s powers set forth?
passages.vernacular: 但我哥哥嘅軍隊出發咗嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但我哥哥的軍隊出發了嗎?

passages.title: Oswald 奧斯華
passages.original: Ay, madam.
passages.vernacular: 係嘅,夫人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是的,夫人。

passages.title: Regan 里根
passages.original: Himself in person there?
passages.vernacular: 佢本人親自在嗰度?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他本人親自在那裡?

passages.title: Oswald 奧斯華
passages.original: Madam, with much ado.
passages.vernacular: 夫人,費咗好大勁。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 夫人,費了很大勁。

passages.original: Your sister is the better soldier.
passages.vernacular: 你姊姊係更好嘅軍人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你姊姊是更好的軍人。

passages.title: Regan 里根
passages.original: Lord Edmund spake not with your lord at home?
passages.vernacular: 愛德蒙大人喺家冇同你家大人講話嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 愛德蒙大人在家沒和你家大人說話嗎?

passages.title: Oswald 奧斯華
passages.original: No, madam.
passages.vernacular: 冇,夫人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 沒有,夫人。

passages.title: Regan 里根
passages.original: What might import my sister’s letter to him?
passages.vernacular: 我姊姊畀佢嘅信有乜嘢意思?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我姊姊給他的信有什麼意思?

passages.title: Oswald 奧斯華
passages.original: I know not, lady.
passages.vernacular: 我唔知道,夫人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我不知道,夫人。

passages.title: Regan 里根
passages.original: Faith, he is posted hence on serious matter.
passages.vernacular: 講真嘅,佢因嚴重嘅事務匆匆離開喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 說真的,他因嚴重的事務匆匆離開了。

passages.original: It was great ignorance, Gloucester’s eyes being out, To let him live.
passages.vernacular: 葛羅斯特嘅眼睛被挖出後,讓佢活住係極大嘅無知。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 葛羅斯特的眼睛被挖出後,讓他活著是極大的無知。

passages.original: Where he arrives he moves All hearts against us.
passages.vernacular: 佢到邊度,就打動所有人嘅心反對我哋。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他到哪裡,就打動所有人的心反對我們。

passages.original: Edmund, I think, is gone In pity of his misery, to dispatch His nighted life;
passages.vernacular: 我想愛德蒙係出於對佢悲慘嘅憐憫,去結束佢黑夜般嘅生命;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我想愛德蒙是出於對他悲慘的憐憫,去結束他黑夜般的生命;

passages.original: moreover to descry The strength o’ th’enemy.
passages.vernacular: 此外仲要查探敵人嘅實力。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 此外還要查探敵人的實力。

passages.title: Oswald 奧斯華
passages.original: I must needs after him, madam, with my letter.
passages.vernacular: 我必須帶住信追佢去,夫人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我必須帶著信追他去,夫人。

passages.title: Regan 里根
passages.original: Our troops set forth tomorrow; stay with us; The ways are dangerous.
passages.vernacular: 我哋嘅軍隊聽日出發;留喺我哋呢度;路上危險。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們的軍隊明天出發;留在我們這裡;路上危險。

passages.title: Oswald 奧斯華
passages.original: I may not, madam: My lady charg’d my duty in this business.
passages.vernacular: 我唔能夠,夫人:我夫人喺呢件事上吩咐咗我嘅職責。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我不能,夫人:我夫人在這件事上吩咐了我的職責。

passages.title: Regan 里根
passages.original: Why should she write to Edmund?
passages.vernacular: 佢點解要畀愛德蒙寫信?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她為什麼要給愛德蒙寫信?

passages.original: Might not you Transport her purposes by word?
passages.vernacular: 你唔能夠把佢嘅意圖口頭帶到嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你不能把她的意圖口頭帶到嗎?

passages.original: Belike, Somethings, I know not what, I’ll love thee much.
passages.vernacular: 或者,有些事,我唔知道係乜嘢,我會好愛你。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 也許,有些事,我不知道是什麼,我會很愛你。

passages.original: Let me unseal the letter.
passages.vernacular: 讓我拆開呢封信。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 讓我拆開這封信。

passages.title: Oswald 奧斯華
passages.original: Madam, I had rather—
passages.vernacular: 夫人,我寧願——
passages.vernacularMandarin: 夫人,我寧願——

passages.title: Regan 里根
passages.original: I know your lady does not love her husband; I am sure of that;
passages.vernacular: 我知道你夫人不愛佢丈夫;呢點我確定;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我知道你夫人不愛她丈夫;這點我確定;

passages.original: and at her late being here She gave strange oeillades and most speaking looks To noble Edmund.
passages.vernacular: 佢最近喺呢度時,對高貴嘅愛德蒙拋咗奇怪嘅媚眼同極其講明問題嘅眼神。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她最近在這裡時,對高貴的愛德蒙拋了奇怪的媚眼和極其說明問題的眼神。

passages.original: I know you are of her bosom.
passages.vernacular: 我知道你係佢嘅心腹。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我知道你是她的心腹。

passages.title: Oswald 奧斯華
passages.original: I, madam?
passages.vernacular: 我,夫人?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我,夫人?

passages.title: Regan 里根
passages.original: I speak in understanding; y’are, I know’t: Therefore I do advise you take this note:
passages.vernacular: 我講嘅係明白人嘅話;你係,我知道:所以我勸你記住呢個:
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我說的是明白人的話;你是,我知道:所以我勸你記住這個:

passages.original: My lord is dead; Edmund and I have talk’d, And more convenient is he for my hand Than for your lady’s.
passages.vernacular: 我嘅丈夫死喇;愛德蒙同我談過,佢對我嘅手比對你夫人嘅手更合適。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我的丈夫死了;愛德蒙和我談過,他對我的手比對你夫人的手更合適。

passages.original: You may gather more.
passages.vernacular: 你可以多推想些。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你可以多推想些。

passages.original: If you do find him, pray you give him this; And when your mistress hears thus much from you, I pray desire her call her wisdom to her.
passages.vernacular: 如果你找到佢,請把呢個畀佢;你夫人聽到你轉述呢啲後,請你叫佢運用佢嘅智慧。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果你找到他,請把這個給他;你夫人聽到你轉述這些後,請你叫她運用她的智慧。

passages.original: So, fare you well.
passages.vernacular: 咁,再見。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那麼,再見。

passages.original: If you do chance to hear of that blind traitor, Preferment falls on him that cuts him off.
passages.vernacular: 如果你碰巧聽到嗰個瞎眼叛徒嘅消息,邊個把佢除掉邊個就得升職。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果你碰巧聽到那個瞎眼叛徒的消息,誰把他除掉誰就得升職。

passages.title: Oswald 奧斯華
passages.original: Would I could meet him, madam!
passages.vernacular: 但願我能遇到佢,夫人!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但願我能遇到他,夫人!

passages.original: I should show What party I do follow.
passages.vernacular: 我會顯示我追隨邊一方。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我會顯示我追隨哪一方。

passages.title: Regan 里根
passages.original: Fare thee well.
passages.vernacular: 再見。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 再見。

passages.original: [Exeunt.]
passages.vernacular: [同下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [同下。]

chapters.title: Act IV, Scene VI — The Country near Dover 第四幕第六場:多佛附近原野

passages.original: Enter Gloucester, and Edgar dressed like a peasant.
passages.vernacular: [葛羅斯特同扮成農夫嘅愛德伽上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [葛羅斯特和扮成農夫的愛德伽上。]

passages.title: Gloucester 葛羅斯特
passages.original: When shall I come to the top of that same hill?
passages.vernacular: 我乜嘢時候才能到嗰座山頂?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我什麼時候才能到那座山頂?

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: You do climb up it now.
passages.vernacular: 你而家正在往上爬。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你現在正在往上爬。

passages.original: Look how we labour.
passages.vernacular: 睇我哋多費力。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 看我們多費力。

passages.title: Gloucester 葛羅斯特
passages.original: Methinks the ground is even.
passages.vernacular: 我覺得地係平嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我覺得地是平的。

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: Horrible steep.
passages.vernacular: 陡得可怕。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 陡得可怕。

passages.original: Hark, do you hear the sea?
passages.vernacular: 聽,你聽到海聲嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 聽,你聽到海聲嗎?

passages.title: Gloucester 葛羅斯特
passages.original: No, truly.
passages.vernacular: 冇,真嘅冇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 沒有,真的沒有。

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: Why, then, your other senses grow imperfect By your eyes’ anguish.
passages.vernacular: 咦,咁你其他嘅感官,因你眼睛嘅痛苦而變得不完整喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 咦,那麼你其他的感官,因你眼睛的痛苦而變得不完整了。

passages.title: Gloucester 葛羅斯特
passages.original: So may it be indeed.
passages.vernacular: 或者確實如此。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 也許確實如此。

passages.original: Methinks thy voice is alter’d; and thou speak’st In better phrase and matter than thou didst.
passages.vernacular: 我覺得你嘅聲音變喇;你講話嘅措辭同內容比以前好。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我覺得你的聲音變了;你說話的措辭和內容比以前好。

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: Y’are much deceiv’d: in nothing am I chang’d But in my garments.
passages.vernacular: 你被騙得好厲害:我乜嘢都冇變,只變咗我嘅衣服。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你被騙得很厲害:我什麼都沒變,只變了我的衣服。

passages.title: Gloucester 葛羅斯特
passages.original: Methinks you’re better spoken.
passages.vernacular: 我覺得你講得更好喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我覺得你說得更好了。

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: Come on, sir; here’s the place.
passages.vernacular: 嚟,先生;就係呢度。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 來,先生;就是這裡。

passages.original: Stand still.
passages.vernacular: 站住別動。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 站住別動。

passages.original: How fearful And dizzy ’tis to cast one’s eyes so low!
passages.vernacular: 把眼睛放得咁低,幾咁可怕、令人暈眩!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 把眼睛放得這麼低,多麼可怕、令人暈眩!

passages.original: The crows and choughs that wing the midway air Show scarce so gross as beetles.
passages.vernacular: 喺半空飛翔嘅烏鴉同寒鴉,睇起嚟不比甲蟲大。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 在半空飛翔的烏鴉和寒鴉,看起來不比甲蟲大。

passages.original: Half way down Hangs one that gathers samphire—dreadful trade!
passages.vernacular: 半山腰掛住一個採海蓬子嘅人——可怕嘅行當!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 半山腰掛著一個採海蓬子的人——可怕的行當!

passages.original: Methinks he seems no bigger than his head.
passages.vernacular: 我覺得佢睇起嚟不比佢嘅頭大。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我覺得他看起來不比他的頭大。

passages.original: The fishermen that walk upon the beach Appear like mice;
passages.vernacular: 喺海灘上行走嘅漁夫睇起嚟像老鼠;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 在海灘上行走的漁夫看起來像老鼠;

passages.original: and yond tall anchoring bark, Diminish’d to her cock;
passages.vernacular: 嗰邊高大嘅錨泊船,縮小成佢嘅小艇;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那邊高大的錨泊船,縮小成它的小艇;

passages.original: her cock a buoy Almost too small for sight: the murmuring surge That on th’unnumber’d idle pebble chafes Cannot be heard so high.
passages.vernacular: 佢嘅小艇像個浮標,小得幾乎睇唔見:嗰喺無數無用卵石上磨擦嘅喧鬧浪濤,從咁高聽唔到。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她的小艇像個浮標,小得幾乎看不見:那在無數無用卵石上磨擦的喧鬧浪濤,從這麼高聽不到。

passages.original: I’ll look no more; Lest my brain turn, and the deficient sight Topple down headlong.
passages.vernacular: 我唔再睇喇;免得我頭暈,視力不足,頭朝下栽倒。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我不再看了;免得我頭暈,視力不足,頭朝下栽倒。

passages.title: Gloucester 葛羅斯特
passages.original: Set me where you stand.
passages.vernacular: 把我安置喺你站嘅地方。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 把我安置在你站的地方。

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: Give me your hand.
passages.vernacular: 把手畀我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 把手給我。

passages.original: You are now within a foot of th’extreme verge.
passages.vernacular: 你而家離最邊緣只有一英尺喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你現在離最邊緣只有一英尺了。

passages.original: For all beneath the moon would I not leap upright.
passages.vernacular: 即使畀我月下嘅一切,我都唔願筆直地跳。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 即使給我月下的一切,我也不願筆直地跳。

passages.title: Gloucester 葛羅斯特
passages.original: Let go my hand.
passages.vernacular: 放開我嘅手。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 放開我的手。

passages.original: Here, friend, ’s another purse; in it a jewel Well worth a poor man’s taking.
passages.vernacular: 嚟,朋友,呢個係另一個錢袋;裡面有一顆寶石,足夠一個窮人攞。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 來,朋友,這是另一個錢袋;裡面有一顆寶石,足夠一個窮人拿。

passages.original: Fairies and gods Prosper it with thee!
passages.vernacular: 願仙子同諸神讓佢為你帶嚟興旺!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 願仙子和諸神讓它為你帶來興旺!

passages.original: Go thou further off; Bid me farewell, and let me hear thee going.
passages.vernacular: 你再走遠啲;向我告別,讓我聽到你走開嘅聲音。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你再走遠一點;向我告別,讓我聽到你走開的聲音。

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: Now fare ye well, good sir.
passages.vernacular: 而家再見,好先生。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 現在再見,好先生。

passages.original: [Seems to go.]
passages.vernacular: [似乎走開。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [似乎走開。]

passages.title: Gloucester 葛羅斯特
passages.original: With all my heart.
passages.vernacular: 衷心再見。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 衷心再見。

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: [Aside.]
passages.vernacular: [旁白。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [旁白。]

passages.original: Why I do trifle thus with his despair Is done to cure it.
passages.vernacular: 我咁樣戲弄佢嘅絕望,係為了治癒佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我這樣戲弄他的絕望,是為了治癒它。

passages.title: Gloucester 葛羅斯特
passages.original: O you mighty gods!
passages.vernacular: 啊你哋強大嘅諸神!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊你們強大的諸神!

passages.original: This world I do renounce, and in your sights, Shake patiently my great affliction off:
passages.vernacular: 我放棄呢世界,喺你哋嘅目光中,耐心地抖掉我巨大嘅苦難:
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我放棄這世界,在你們的目光中,耐心地抖掉我巨大的苦難:

passages.original: If I could bear it longer, and not fall To quarrel with your great opposeless wills, My snuff and loathed part of nature should Burn itself out.
passages.vernacular: 如果我能再忍受更久,不至於落到去同你哋偉大無可抗拒嘅意志爭吵,我呢燃剩嘅燭芯同天性中令人憎惡嘅部分,就會自己燒盡。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果我能再忍受更久,不至於落到去與你們偉大無可抗拒的意志爭吵,我這燃剩的燭芯和天性中令人憎惡的部分,就會自己燒盡。

passages.original: If Edgar live, O, bless him!
passages.vernacular: 如果愛德伽仲活住,啊,祝福佢!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果愛德伽還活著,啊,祝福他!

passages.original: Now, fellow, fare thee well.
passages.vernacular: 而家,朋友,再見。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 現在,朋友,再見。

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: Gone, sir, farewell.
passages.vernacular: 走喇,先生,再見。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 走了,先生,再見。

passages.original: [Gloucester leaps, and falls along]
passages.vernacular: [葛羅斯特跳下,撲倒喺地。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [葛羅斯特跳下,撲倒在地。]

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: And yet I know not how conceit may rob The treasury of life when life itself Yields to the theft.
passages.vernacular: 然而我唔知道想像點能偷走生命嘅寶藏,當生命本身屈服於偷竊。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 然而我不知道想像怎麼能偷走生命的寶藏,當生命本身屈服於偷竊。

passages.original: Had he been where he thought, By this had thought been past.
passages.vernacular: 如果佢喺佢所想嘅地方,呢陣思想已成過去。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果他在他所想的地方,這時思想已成過去。

passages.original: Alive or dead?
passages.vernacular: 活住定係死喇?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 活著還是死了?

passages.original: Ho you, sir! friend!
passages.vernacular: 喂,先生!朋友!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 喂,先生!朋友!

passages.original: Hear you, sir? speak!
passages.vernacular: 先生,你聽到嗎?講話!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 先生,你聽到嗎?說話!

passages.original: Thus might he pass indeed: yet he revives.
passages.vernacular: 佢確實可能咁樣死去:然而佢又醒過嚟喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他確實可能這樣死去:然而他又醒過來了。

passages.original: What are you, sir?
passages.vernacular: 你係邊個,先生?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你是誰,先生?

passages.title: Gloucester 葛羅斯特
passages.original: Away, and let me die.
passages.vernacular: 走開,讓我死。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 走開,讓我死。

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: Hadst thou been aught but gossamer, feathers, air, So many fathom down precipitating, Thou’dst shiver’d like an egg:
passages.vernacular: 如果你係蛛絲、羽毛、空氣以外嘅嘢,從咁多噚下墜落,你早該像雞蛋一樣摔碎:
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果你是蛛絲、羽毛、空氣以外的東西,從這麼多噚下墜落,你早該像雞蛋一樣摔碎:

passages.original: but thou dost breathe; Hast heavy substance; bleed’st not; speak’st; art sound.
passages.vernacular: 但你喺呼吸;有沉重嘅實體;不流血;會講話;完好無損。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但你在呼吸;有沉重的實體;不流血;會說話;完好無損。

passages.original: Ten masts at each make not the altitude Which thou hast perpendicularly fell.
passages.vernacular: 十根桅杆接起嚟都不及你垂直墜落嘅高度。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 十根桅杆接起來也不及你垂直墜落的高度。

passages.original: Thy life is a miracle.
passages.vernacular: 你嘅性命係個奇蹟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你的性命是個奇蹟。

passages.original: Speak yet again.
passages.vernacular: 再講一次話。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 再說一次話。

passages.title: Gloucester 葛羅斯特
passages.original: But have I fall’n, or no?
passages.vernacular: 但我係跌下嚟喇,定係冇?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但我是跌下來了,還是沒有?

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: From the dread summit of this chalky bourn.
passages.vernacular: 從呢白堊峭壁可怕嘅頂峰。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 從這白堊峭壁可怕的頂峰。

passages.original: Look up a-height, the shrill-gorg’d lark so far Cannot be seen or heard.
passages.vernacular: 抬頭向上睇:尖聲鳴叫嘅雲雀咁遠,睇唔見都聽唔到。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 抬頭向上看:尖聲鳴叫的雲雀那麼遠,看不見也聽不到。

passages.original: Do but look up.
passages.vernacular: 只要抬頭睇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 只要抬頭看。

passages.title: Gloucester 葛羅斯特
passages.original: Alack, I have no eyes.
passages.vernacular: 哎呀,我冇眼睛。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎呀,我沒有眼睛。

passages.original: Is wretchedness depriv’d that benefit To end itself by death?
passages.vernacular: 難道悲慘連用死亡結束自己嘅呢份好處都被剝奪咗嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 難道悲慘連用死亡結束自己的這份好處也被剝奪了嗎?

passages.original: ’Twas yet some comfort When misery could beguile the tyrant’s rage And frustrate his proud will.
passages.vernacular: 當悲慘能騙過暴君嘅怒氣,挫敗佢驕傲嘅意志時,嗰定係種安慰。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 當悲慘能騙過暴君的怒氣,挫敗他驕傲的意志時,那還是種安慰。

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: Give me your arm. Up, so. How is’t?
passages.vernacular: 把手臂畀我。起嚟,咁樣。點樣?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 把手臂給我。起來,這樣。怎麼樣?

passages.original: Feel you your legs? You stand.
passages.vernacular: 你感覺到腿嗎?你站住喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你感覺到腿嗎?你站著了。

passages.title: Gloucester 葛羅斯特
passages.original: Too well, too well.
passages.vernacular: 太好喇,太好喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 太好了,太好了。

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: This is above all strangeness.
passages.vernacular: 呢超出所有奇怪。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這超出所有奇怪。

passages.original: Upon the crown o’ the cliff what thing was that Which parted from you?
passages.vernacular: 喺懸崖頂上,同你分開嘅嗰個嘢係乜嘢?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 在懸崖頂上,和你分開的那個東西是什麼?

passages.title: Gloucester 葛羅斯特
passages.original: A poor unfortunate beggar.
passages.vernacular: 一個可憐不幸嘅乞丐。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 一個可憐不幸的乞丐。

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: As I stood here below, methought his eyes Were two full moons;
passages.vernacular: 我站喺下面時,覺得佢嘅眼睛係兩輪滿月;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我站在下面時,覺得他的眼睛是兩輪滿月;

passages.original: he had a thousand noses, Horns whelk’d and waved like the enraged sea.
passages.vernacular: 佢有一千個鼻子,角像發怒嘅海一樣起伏彎曲。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他有一千個鼻子,角像發怒的海一樣起伏彎曲。

passages.original: It was some fiend.
passages.vernacular: 嗰個係個魔鬼。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那是個魔鬼。

passages.original: Therefore, thou happy father, Think that the clearest gods, who make them honours Of men’s impossibilities, have preserv’d thee.
passages.vernacular: 所以,你呢幸福嘅父親,想想嗰最清明嘅諸神,佢哋把人唔可能嘅事當作自己嘅榮耀,保全咗你。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 所以,你這幸福的父親,想想那最清明的諸神,他們把人不可能的事當作自己的榮耀,保全了你。

passages.title: Gloucester 葛羅斯特
passages.original: I do remember now: henceforth I’ll bear Affliction till it do cry out itself ‘Enough, enough,’ and die.
passages.vernacular: 我而家記起嚟喇:從今以後我要忍受苦難,直到佢自己喊「夠喇,夠喇」,然後死去。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我現在記起來了:從今以後我要忍受苦難,直到它自己喊「夠了,夠了」,然後死去。

passages.original: That thing you speak of, I took it for a man;
passages.vernacular: 你講嘅嗰嘢,我把佢當作人;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你說的那東西,我把它當作人;

passages.original: often ’twould say, ‘The fiend, the fiend’; he led me to that place.
passages.vernacular: 佢常講「魔鬼,魔鬼」;係佢領我到嗰地方。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 它常說「魔鬼,魔鬼」;是它領我到那地方。

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: Bear free and patient thoughts.
passages.vernacular: 保持自由同耐心嘅想法。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 保持自由和耐心的想法。

passages.original: But who comes here?
passages.vernacular: 但呢度嚟嘅係邊個?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但這裡來的是誰?

passages.original: Enter Lear, fantastically dressed up with flowers.
passages.vernacular: [李爾上,古怪地用花朵裝扮。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [李爾上,古怪地用花朵裝扮。]

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: The safer sense will ne’er accommodate His master thus.
passages.vernacular: 理智較健全嘅人,絕唔會咁樣打扮佢嘅主人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 理智較健全的人,絕不會這樣打扮他的主人。

passages.title: Lear 李爾
passages.original: No, they cannot touch me for coining.
passages.vernacular: 不,佢哋唔能夠因我鑄錢而碰我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,他們不能因我鑄錢而碰我。

passages.original: I am the King himself.
passages.vernacular: 我就係國王本人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我就是國王本人。

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: O thou side-piercing sight!
passages.vernacular: 啊你呢刺穿肋骨嘅景象!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊你這刺穿肋骨的景象!

passages.title: Lear 李爾
passages.original: Nature’s above art in that respect.
passages.vernacular: 喺嗰方面,自然高過藝術。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 在那方面,自然高過藝術。

passages.original: There’s your press money.
passages.vernacular: 呢個係你哋嘅徵兵費。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是你們的徵兵費。

passages.original: That fellow handles his bow like a crow-keeper:
passages.vernacular: 嗰傢伙拉弓像個趕烏鴉嘅:
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那傢伙拉弓像個趕烏鴉的:

passages.original: draw me a clothier’s yard.
passages.vernacular: 畀我拉滿一布匹碼(箭長)。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 給我拉滿一布匹碼(箭長)。

passages.original: Look, look, a mouse!
passages.vernacular: 睇,睇,一隻老鼠!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 看,看,一隻老鼠!

passages.original: Peace, peace, this piece of toasted cheese will do’t.
passages.vernacular: 安靜,安靜,呢塊烤乳酪就行。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 安靜,安靜,這塊烤乳酪就行。

passages.original: There’s my gauntlet; I’ll prove it on a giant.
passages.vernacular: 呢個係我嘅鐵手套;我要喺一個巨人身上證明佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是我的鐵手套;我要在一個巨人身上證明它。

passages.original: Bring up the brown bills.
passages.vernacular: 把褐色嘅戟攞上嚟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 把褐色的戟拿上來。

passages.original: O, well flown, bird!
passages.vernacular: 啊,飛得好,鳥!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,飛得好,鳥!

passages.original: i’ the clout, i’ the clout. Hewgh!
passages.vernacular: 中靶心,中靶心。嗬!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 中靶心,中靶心。嗬!

passages.original: Give the word.
passages.vernacular: 講口令。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 說口令。

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: Sweet marjoram.
passages.vernacular: 甜馬郁蘭。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 甜馬郁蘭。

passages.title: Lear 李爾
passages.original: Pass.
passages.vernacular: 通過。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 通過。

passages.title: Gloucester 葛羅斯特
passages.original: I know that voice.
passages.vernacular: 我認得嗰聲音。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我認得那聲音。

passages.title: Lear 李爾
passages.original: Ha!
passages.vernacular: 哈!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哈!

passages.original: Goneril with a white beard!
passages.vernacular: 白鬍子嘅高納麗!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 白鬍子的高納麗!

passages.original: They flattered me like a dog; and told me I had white hairs in my beard ere the black ones were there.
passages.vernacular: 佢哋像對狗一樣奉承我;講我鬍子裡長出白髮,仲早於黑鬚。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他們像對狗一樣奉承我;說我鬍子裡長出白髮,還早於黑鬚。

passages.original: To say ‘ay’ and ‘no’ to everything I said ‘ay’ and ‘no’ to was no good divinity.
passages.vernacular: 對我講嘅一切都講「係」同「唔係」,呢唔係好神學。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 對我說的一切都說「是」和「不是」,這不是好神學。

passages.original: When the rain came to wet me once, and the wind to make me chatter;
passages.vernacular: 當雨一來淋濕我,風使我牙齒打顫;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 當雨一來淋濕我,風使我牙齒打顫;

passages.original: when the thunder would not peace at my bidding;
passages.vernacular: 當雷唔肯聽我嘅命令平息;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 當雷不肯聽我的命令平息;

passages.original: there I found ’em, there I smelt ’em out.
passages.vernacular: 喺嗰時我找到咗佢哋,喺嗰時我嗅出咗佢哋。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 在那時我找到了她們,在那時我嗅出了她們。

passages.original: Go to, they are not men o’ their words: they told me I was everything;
passages.vernacular: 得喇,佢哋唔係言出必行嘅人:佢哋講我係萬能嘅;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 得了,她們不是言出必行的人:她們說我是萬能的;

passages.original: ’tis a lie, I am not ague-proof.
passages.vernacular: 係謊言,我並不免疫於寒熱病。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是謊言,我並不免疫於寒熱病。

passages.title: Gloucester 葛羅斯特
passages.original: The trick of that voice I do well remember: Is’t not the King?
passages.vernacular: 嗰聲音嘅腔調我記得好清楚:唔係國王嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那聲音的腔調我記得很清楚:不是國王嗎?

passages.title: Lear 李爾
passages.original: Ay, every inch a king.
passages.vernacular: 係,每一寸都係國王。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是,每一寸都是國王。

passages.original: When I do stare, see how the subject quakes.
passages.vernacular: 當我瞪眼時,睇臣民點樣顫抖。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 當我瞪眼時,看臣民怎樣顫抖。

passages.original: I pardon that man’s life.
passages.vernacular: 我赦免嗰人嘅性命。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我赦免那人的性命。

passages.original: What was thy cause? Adultery?
passages.vernacular: 你犯乜嘢罪?通姦?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你犯什麼罪?通姦?

passages.original: Thou shalt not die: die for adultery!
passages.vernacular: 你唔會死:為通姦而死!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你不會死:為通姦而死!

passages.original: No: The wren goes to’t, and the small gilded fly Does lecher in my sight.
passages.vernacular: 不:鷦鷯都做呢事,小小嘅金蒼蠅都喺我眼前淫蕩。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不:鷦鷯也做這事,小小的金蒼蠅也在我眼前淫蕩。

passages.original: Let copulation thrive; For Gloucester’s bastard son was kinder to his father Than my daughters got ’tween the lawful sheets.
passages.vernacular: 讓交媾興旺吧;因為葛羅斯特嘅私生子對佢父親,比我嗰啲喺合法床單間生嘅女兒更孝順。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 讓交媾興旺吧;因為葛羅斯特的私生子對他父親,比我那些在合法床單間生的女兒更孝順。

passages.original: To’t, luxury, pell-mell!
passages.vernacular: 做吧,淫慾,亂做一團!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 做吧,淫慾,亂做一團!

passages.original: for I lack soldiers.
passages.vernacular: 因為我缺少士兵。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 因為我缺少士兵。

passages.original: Behold yond simp’ring dame, Whose face between her forks presages snow;
passages.vernacular: 睇嗰邊嗰個假笑嘅婦人,佢嘅臉喺兩腿之間預示住雪;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 看那邊那個假笑的婦人,她的臉在兩腿之間預示著雪;

passages.original: That minces virtue, and does shake the head To hear of pleasure’s name.
passages.vernacular: 佢裝腔作勢扮德行,一聽到快樂嘅名字就搖頭。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她裝腔作勢扮德行,一聽到快樂的名字就搖頭。

passages.original: The fitchew nor the soiled horse goes to’t with a more riotous appetite.
passages.vernacular: 臭鼬同發情嘅馬都唔會以更放縱嘅胃口去做呢事。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 臭鼬和發情的馬也不會以更放縱的胃口去做這事。

passages.original: Down from the waist they are centaurs, though women all above.
passages.vernacular: 從腰以下佢哋係半人馬,雖然上面全係女人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 從腰以下她們是半人馬,雖然上面全是女人。

passages.original: But to the girdle do the gods inherit, beneath is all the fiend’s;
passages.vernacular: 只到腰帶為止係諸神繼承,下面全屬魔鬼;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 只到腰帶為止是諸神繼承,下面全屬魔鬼;

passages.original: there’s hell, there’s darkness, there is the sulphurous pit;
passages.vernacular: 嗰度係地獄,係黑暗,係硫磺坑;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那裡是地獄,是黑暗,是硫磺坑;

passages.original: burning, scalding, stench, consumption.
passages.vernacular: 燃燒、灼燙、惡臭、腐蝕。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 燃燒、灼燙、惡臭、腐蝕。

passages.original: Fie, fie, fie! pah, pah!
passages.vernacular: 呸,呸,呸!啐,啐!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 呸,呸,呸!啐,啐!

passages.original: Give me an ounce of civet, good apothecary, to sweeten my imagination.
passages.vernacular: 畀我一盎司靈貓香,好藥劑師,讓我嘅想像變甜。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 給我一盎司靈貓香,好藥劑師,讓我的想像變甜。

passages.original: There’s money for thee.
passages.vernacular: 呢個係畀你嘅錢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是給你的錢。

passages.title: Gloucester 葛羅斯特
passages.original: O, let me kiss that hand!
passages.vernacular: 啊,讓我吻嗰隻手!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,讓我吻那隻手!

passages.title: Lear 李爾
passages.original: Let me wipe it first; it smells of mortality.
passages.vernacular: 讓我先擦擦佢;佢有人類必死嘅氣味。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 讓我先擦擦它;它有人類必死的氣味。

passages.title: Gloucester 葛羅斯特
passages.original: O ruin’d piece of nature, this great world Shall so wear out to naught.
passages.vernacular: 啊,自然嘅破碎之作,呢偉大嘅世界都將咁樣消耗殆盡。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,自然的破碎之作,這偉大的世界也將這樣消耗殆盡。

passages.original: Dost thou know me?
passages.vernacular: 你認得我嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你認得我嗎?

passages.title: Lear 李爾
passages.original: I remember thine eyes well enough.
passages.vernacular: 我好記得你嘅眼睛。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我很記得你的眼睛。

passages.original: Dost thou squiny at me?
passages.vernacular: 你向我斜眼嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你向我斜眼嗎?

passages.original: No, do thy worst, blind Cupid; I’ll not love.
passages.vernacular: 不,做你最壞嘅吧,瞎眼嘅丘比特;我唔會愛。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,做你最壞的吧,瞎眼的丘比特;我不會愛。

passages.original: Read thou this challenge; mark but the penning of it.
passages.vernacular: 讀呢份挑戰書;只要注意佢係點樣寫嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 讀這份挑戰書;只要注意它是怎樣寫的。

passages.title: Gloucester 葛羅斯特
passages.original: Were all the letters suns, I could not see one.
passages.vernacular: 即使所有字母都係太陽,我都睇唔到一個。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 即使所有字母都是太陽,我也看不到一個。

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: I would not take this from report, It is, and my heart breaks at it.
passages.vernacular: 我唔願從傳聞得知呢個,佢確係如此,我嘅心為此而碎。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我不願從傳聞得知這個,它確是如此,我的心為此而碎。

passages.title: Lear 李爾
passages.original: Read.
passages.vernacular: 讀。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 讀。

passages.title: Gloucester 葛羅斯特
passages.original: What, with the case of eyes?
passages.vernacular: 乜嘢,用空眼眶?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼,用空眼眶?

passages.title: Lear 李爾
passages.original: O, ho, are you there with me?
passages.vernacular: 啊,嗬,你就喺呢點上跟我講話?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,嗬,你就在這點上跟我說話?

passages.original: No eyes in your head, nor no money in your purse?
passages.vernacular: 頭上冇眼睛,錢袋裡冇錢?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 頭上沒有眼睛,錢袋裡沒有錢?

passages.original: Your eyes are in a heavy case, your purse in a light, yet you see how this world goes.
passages.vernacular: 你嘅眼睛處境沉重,你嘅錢袋處境輕,不過你睇,呢世界點樣運行。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你的眼睛處境沉重,你的錢袋處境輕,可是你看,這世界怎樣運行。

passages.title: Gloucester 葛羅斯特
passages.original: I see it feelingly.
passages.vernacular: 我感覺地睇見佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我感覺地看見它。

passages.title: Lear 李爾
passages.original: What, art mad?
passages.vernacular: 乜嘢,你瘋咗嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼,你瘋了嗎?

passages.original: A man may see how the world goes with no eyes.
passages.vernacular: 一個人冇眼睛都能睇到世界點樣運行。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 一個人沒有眼睛也能看到世界怎樣運行。

passages.original: Look with thine ears.
passages.vernacular: 用你嘅耳朵睇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 用你的耳朵看。

passages.original: See how yon justice rails upon yon simple thief.
passages.vernacular: 睇嗰法官點樣辱罵嗰個單純嘅小偷。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 看那法官怎樣辱罵那個單純的小偷。

passages.original: Hark, in thine ear: change places; and, handy-dandy, which is the justice, which is the thief?
passages.vernacular: 聽,喺你耳邊:換位置;然後,手兒換,邊個係法官,邊個係小偷?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 聽,在你耳邊:換位置;然後,手兒換,哪個是法官,哪個是小偷?

passages.original: Thou hast seen a farmer’s dog bark at a beggar?
passages.vernacular: 你見過農夫嘅狗對乞丐吠叫嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你見過農夫的狗對乞丐吠叫嗎?

passages.title: Gloucester 葛羅斯特
passages.original: Ay, sir.
passages.vernacular: 見過,先生。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 見過,先生。

passages.title: Lear 李爾
passages.original: And the creature run from the cur?
passages.vernacular: 而嗰個人逃離嗰條惡狗?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 而那個人逃離那條惡狗?

passages.original: There thou mightst behold the great image of authority:
passages.vernacular: 喺嗰度你可以睇到權威嘅偉大形象:
passages.vernacularMandarin: 在那裡你可以看到權威的偉大形象:

passages.original: a dog’s obeyed in office.
passages.vernacular: 狗喺職位上被服從。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 狗在職位上被服從。

passages.original: Thou rascal beadle, hold thy bloody hand!
passages.vernacular: 你呢無賴教區差役,住你血腥嘅手!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你這無賴教區差役,住你血腥的手!

passages.original: Why dost thou lash that whore?
passages.vernacular: 你點解鞭打嗰個娼妓?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你為什麼鞭打那個娼妓?

passages.original: Strip thine own back; Thou hotly lusts to use her in that kind For which thou whipp’st her.
passages.vernacular: 脫掉你自己嘅背;你熱切地想對佢施行你鞭打佢嘅嗰種勾當。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 脫掉你自己的背;你熱切地想對她施行你鞭打她的那種勾當。

passages.original: The usurer hangs the cozener.
passages.vernacular: 放高利貸嘅絞死騙子。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 放高利貸的絞死騙子。

passages.original: Through tatter’d clothes great vices do appear;
passages.vernacular: 透過破爛衣服,大惡行顯現出嚟;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 透過破爛衣服,大惡行顯現出來;

passages.original: Robes and furr’d gowns hide all.
passages.vernacular: 長袍同皮草大衣掩蓋一切。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 長袍和皮草大衣掩蓋一切。

passages.original: Plate sin with gold, And the strong lance of justice hurtless breaks;
passages.vernacular: 用金子鍍上罪行,正義嘅強矛就無害地折斷;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 用金子鍍上罪行,正義的強矛就無害地折斷;

passages.original: Arm it in rags, a pygmy’s straw does pierce it.
passages.vernacular: 畀佢穿上破衣,侏儒嘅稻草都能刺穿佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 給它穿上破衣,侏儒的稻草也能刺穿它。

passages.original: None does offend, none, I say none; I’ll able ’em;
passages.vernacular: 冇人犯罪,冇,我講冇;我嚟擔保佢哋;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 沒有人犯罪,沒有,我說沒有;我來擔保他們;

passages.original: Take that of me, my friend, who have the power To seal the accuser’s lips.
passages.vernacular: 從我呢度攞去呢個,我嘅朋友,我有權封住控訴者嘅嘴。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 從我這裡拿去這個,我的朋友,我有權封住控訴者的嘴。

passages.original: Get thee glass eyes, And like a scurvy politician, seem To see the things thou dost not.
passages.vernacular: 去弄副玻璃眼睛,像個卑鄙嘅政客,假裝睇到你睇唔到嘅事。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 去弄副玻璃眼睛,像個卑鄙的政客,假裝看到你看不到的事。

passages.original: Now, now, now, now: Pull off my boots: harder, harder, so.
passages.vernacular: 而家,而家,而家,而家:脫掉我嘅靴子:用力,用力,咁樣。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 現在,現在,現在,現在:脫掉我的靴子:用力,用力,這樣。

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: O, matter and impertinency mix’d!
passages.vernacular: 啊,有意義嘅同無關緊要嘅混喺一起!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,有意義的和無關緊要的混在一起!

passages.original: Reason in madness!
passages.vernacular: 瘋狂中嘅理智!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 瘋狂中的理智!

passages.title: Lear 李爾
passages.original: If thou wilt weep my fortunes, take my eyes.
passages.vernacular: 如果你要為我嘅命運哭,攞我嘅眼睛去吧。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果你要為我的命運哭,拿我的眼睛去吧。

passages.original: I know thee well enough, thy name is Gloucester.
passages.vernacular: 我好了解你,你嘅名字係葛羅斯特。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我很了解你,你的名字是葛羅斯特。

passages.original: Thou must be patient; we came crying hither: Thou know’st the first time that we smell the air We wawl and cry.
passages.vernacular: 你必須忍耐;我哋哭住嚟到呢度:你知道我哋第一次嗅到空氣時,就哇哇啼哭。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你必須忍耐;我們哭著來到這裡:你知道我們第一次嗅到空氣時,就哇哇啼哭。

passages.original: I will preach to thee: mark.
passages.vernacular: 我要向你宣講:注意。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我要向你宣講:注意。

passages.title: Gloucester 葛羅斯特
passages.original: Alack, alack the day!
passages.vernacular: 哎呀,哎呀,幾咁不幸嘅日子!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎呀,哎呀,多麼不幸的日子!

passages.title: Lear 李爾
passages.original: When we are born, we cry that we are come To this great stage of fools.
passages.vernacular: 我哋出生時,哭係因為嚟到呢個偉大嘅傻瓜舞台。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們出生時,哭是因為來到這個偉大的傻瓜舞台。

passages.original: This a good block: It were a delicate stratagem to shoe A troop of horse with felt.
passages.vernacular: 呢頂帽子楦不錯:畀一隊馬用氈子包蹄,真係個精巧嘅策略。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這頂帽子楦不錯:給一隊馬用氈子包蹄,真是個精巧的策略。

passages.original: I’ll put’t in proof And when I have stol’n upon these son-in-laws, Then kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill!
passages.vernacular: 我要試試;當我偷偷接近呢啲女婿,就殺,殺,殺,殺,殺,殺!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我要試試;當我偷偷接近這些女婿,就殺,殺,殺,殺,殺,殺!

passages.original: Enter a Gentleman with Attendants.
passages.vernacular: [一位紳士帶侍從哋上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [一位紳士帶侍從們上。]

passages.title: Gentleman 紳士
passages.original: O, here he is: lay hand upon him.
passages.vernacular: 啊,佢喺呢度:抓住佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,他在這裡:抓住他。

passages.original: Sir, Your most dear daughter—
passages.vernacular: 先生,您最親愛嘅女兒——
passages.vernacularMandarin: 先生,您最親愛的女兒——

passages.title: Lear 李爾
passages.original: No rescue?
passages.vernacular: 冇救援嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 沒有救援嗎?

passages.original: What, a prisoner?
passages.vernacular: 乜嘢,一個囚犯?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼,一個囚犯?

passages.original: I am even The natural fool of fortune.
passages.vernacular: 我真係命運嘅天生傻瓜。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我真是命運的天生傻瓜。

passages.original: Use me well; You shall have ransom.
passages.vernacular: 好好待我;你哋會得到贖金。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好好待我;你們會得到贖金。

passages.original: Let me have surgeons; I am cut to the brains.
passages.vernacular: 畀我外科醫生;我被砍到腦子喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 給我外科醫生;我被砍到腦子了。

passages.title: Gentleman 紳士
passages.original: You shall have anything.
passages.vernacular: 您會得到任何嘢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 您會得到任何東西。

passages.title: Lear 李爾
passages.original: No seconds? All myself?
passages.vernacular: 冇副手?全靠我自己?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 沒有副手?全靠我自己?

passages.original: Why, this would make a man a man of salt, To use his eyes for garden water-pots, Ay, and for laying autumn’s dust.
passages.vernacular: 咦,呢會把一個人變成鹽人,用佢嘅眼睛當園子嘅澆水壺,係嘅,仲用嚟壓住秋天嘅塵土。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 咦,這會把一個人變成鹽人,用他的眼睛當園子的澆水壺,是的,還用來壓住秋天的塵土。

passages.title: Gentleman 紳士
passages.original: Good sir.
passages.vernacular: 好先生。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好先生。

passages.title: Lear 李爾
passages.original: I will die bravely, like a smug bridegroom. What!
passages.vernacular: 我要勇敢地死,像個整潔嘅新郎。乜嘢!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我要勇敢地死,像個整潔的新郎。什麼!

passages.original: I will be jovial.
passages.vernacular: 我要歡樂。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我要歡樂。

passages.original: Come, come, I am a king, my masters, know you that.
passages.vernacular: 嚟,嚟,我係國王,各位先生,你哋要知道。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 來,來,我是國王,各位先生,你們要知道。

passages.title: Gentleman 紳士
passages.original: You are a royal one, and we obey you.
passages.vernacular: 您係位王者,我哋服從您。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 您是位王者,我們服從您。

passages.title: Lear 李爾
passages.original: Then there’s life in’t.
passages.vernacular: 咁仲有生命喺裡面。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那麼還有生命在裡面。

passages.original: Come, and you get it, You shall get it by running.
passages.vernacular: 嚟,如果你要得到佢,你得靠奔跑去得。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 來,如果你要得到它,你得靠奔跑去得。

passages.original: Sa, sa, sa, sa!
passages.vernacular: 薩,薩,薩,薩!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 薩,薩,薩,薩!

passages.original: [Exit running. Attendants follow.]
passages.vernacular: [奔跑住下。侍從哋跟隨。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [奔跑著下。侍從們跟隨。]

passages.title: Gentleman 紳士
passages.original: A sight most pitiful in the meanest wretch, Past speaking of in a king!
passages.vernacular: 呢景象喺最卑賤嘅可憐人身上已極為可憐,喺國王身上更係無法言講!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這景象在最卑賤的可憐人身上已極為可憐,在國王身上更是無法言說!

passages.original: Thou hast one daughter Who redeems nature from the general curse Which twain have brought her to.
passages.vernacular: 你仲有一個女兒,佢使自然免於兩個女兒帶畀佢嘅普遍詛咒。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你還有一個女兒,她使自然免於兩個女兒帶給她的普遍詛咒。

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: Hail, gentle sir.
passages.vernacular: 向你致敬,好先生。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 向你致敬,好先生。

passages.title: Gentleman 紳士
passages.original: Sir, speed you.
passages.vernacular: 先生,祝你順利。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 先生,祝你順利。

passages.original: What’s your will?
passages.vernacular: 你有乜嘢事?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你有什麼事?

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: Do you hear aught, sir, of a battle toward?
passages.vernacular: 先生,你聽講過有戰事要嚟嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 先生,你聽說過有戰事要來嗎?

passages.title: Gentleman 紳士
passages.original: Most sure and vulgar.
passages.vernacular: 好確實,而且係盡人皆知。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 非常確實,而且是盡人皆知。

passages.original: Everyone hears that, which can distinguish sound.
passages.vernacular: 凡是能辨別聲音嘅人都聽到喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 凡是能辨別聲音的人都聽到了。

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: But, by your favour, How near’s the other army?
passages.vernacular: 但請問,另一支軍隊離呢度多近?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但請問,另一支軍隊離這裡多近?

passages.title: Gentleman 紳士
passages.original: Near and on speedy foot; the main descry Stands on the hourly thought.
passages.vernacular: 好近,而且行進迅速;主力隨時可見。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 很近,而且行進迅速;主力隨時可見。

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: I thank you sir, that’s all.
passages.vernacular: 謝謝你先生,就呢啲。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 謝謝你先生,就這些。

passages.title: Gentleman 紳士
passages.original: Though that the queen on special cause is here, Her army is mov’d on.
passages.vernacular: 雖然王后因特殊原因喺此,佢嘅軍隊已經開走喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 雖然王后因特殊原因在此,她的軍隊已經開走了。

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: I thank you, sir.
passages.vernacular: 謝謝你,先生。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 謝謝你,先生。

passages.original: [Exit Gentleman.]
passages.vernacular: [紳士下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [紳士下。]

passages.title: Gloucester 葛羅斯特
passages.original: You ever-gentle gods, take my breath from me;
passages.vernacular: 你哋永遠仁慈嘅諸神,把我嘅氣息攞走吧;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你們永遠仁慈的諸神,把我的氣息拿走吧;

passages.original: Let not my worser spirit tempt me again To die before you please.
passages.vernacular: 唔好畀我較壞嘅精神再誘惑我喺你哋許可之前去死。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 別讓我較壞的精神再誘惑我在你們許可之前去死。

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: Well pray you, father.
passages.vernacular: 好,請你,父親。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好,請你,父親。

passages.title: Gloucester 葛羅斯特
passages.original: Now, good sir, what are you?
passages.vernacular: 而家,好先生,你係乜嘢人?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 現在,好先生,你是什麼人?

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: A most poor man, made tame to fortune’s blows;
passages.vernacular: 一個極貧窮嘅人,被命運嘅打擊馴服;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 一個極貧窮的人,被命運的打擊馴服;

passages.original: Who, by the art of known and feeling sorrows, Am pregnant to good pity.
passages.vernacular: 憑已知並感受過嘅悲傷嘅技藝,我充滿好嘅憐憫。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 憑已知並感受過的悲傷的技藝,我充滿好的憐憫。

passages.original: Give me your hand, I’ll lead you to some biding.
passages.vernacular: 把手畀我,我領你去某個住處。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 把手給我,我領你去某個住處。

passages.title: Gloucester 葛羅斯特
passages.original: Hearty thanks: The bounty and the benison of heaven To boot, and boot.
passages.vernacular: 衷心感謝:再加上天上嘅恩賜同祝福,再加,再加。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 衷心感謝:再加上天上的恩賜與祝福,再加,再加。

passages.original: Enter Oswald.
passages.vernacular: [奧斯華上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [奧斯華上。]

passages.title: Oswald 奧斯華
passages.original: A proclaim’d prize! Most happy!
passages.vernacular: 一個公開懸賞嘅獎品!太幸運喇!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 一個公開懸賞的獎品!太幸運了!

passages.original: That eyeless head of thine was first fram’d flesh To raise my fortunes.
passages.vernacular: 你嗰無眼嘅頭,起初係為了抬高我嘅前程而造成嘅肉。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你那無眼的頭,起初是為了抬高我的前程而造成的肉。

passages.original: Thou old unhappy traitor, Briefly thyself remember.
passages.vernacular: 你呢年老不幸嘅叛徒,快速回想你自己。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你這年老不幸的叛徒,快速回想你自己。

passages.original: The sword is out That must destroy thee.
passages.vernacular: 嗰要毀滅你嘅劍已出鞘。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那要毀滅你的劍已出鞘。

passages.title: Gloucester 葛羅斯特
passages.original: Now let thy friendly hand Put strength enough to’t.
passages.vernacular: 而家讓你友善嘅手畀佢足夠嘅力量。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 現在讓你友善的手給它足夠的力量。

passages.original: [Edgar interposes.]
passages.vernacular: [愛德伽插身阻擋。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [愛德伽插身阻擋。]

passages.title: Oswald 奧斯華
passages.original: Wherefore, bold peasant, Dar’st thou support a publish’d traitor?
passages.vernacular: 點解,大膽嘅農夫,你敢支持一個公開宣告嘅叛徒?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 為什麼,大膽的農夫,你敢支持一個公開宣告的叛徒?

passages.original: Hence; Lest that th’infection of his fortune take Like hold on thee.
passages.vernacular: 走開;免得佢命運嘅傳染同樣感染你。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 走開;免得他命運的傳染同樣感染你。

passages.original: Let go his arm.
passages.vernacular: 放開佢嘅手臂。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 放開他的手臂。

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: Chill not let go, zir, without vurther ’casion.
passages.vernacular: 冇進一步理由,我不放,先生。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 沒有進一步理由,我不放,先生。

passages.title: Oswald 奧斯華
passages.original: Let go, slave, or thou diest!
passages.vernacular: 放手,奴才,否則你死!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 放手,奴才,否則你死!

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: Good gentleman, go your gait, and let poor volke pass.
passages.vernacular: 好紳士,走你嘅路,讓窮人過。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好紳士,走你的路,讓窮人過。

passages.original: An chud ha’ bin zwaggered out of my life, ’twould not ha’ bin zo long as ’tis by a vortnight.
passages.vernacular: 如果我能被吹牛趕出性命,都唔會活到而家咁長,超過兩個星期。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果我能被吹牛趕出性命,也不會活到現在這麼長,超過兩個星期。

passages.original: Nay, come not near th’old man; keep out, che vor ye, or ise try whether your costard or my ballow be the harder: chill be plain with you.
passages.vernacular: 不,別靠近嗰老人;走開,我告訴你,否則我試試係你嘅腦袋硬定係我嘅棍子硬:我跟你直講。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,別靠近那老人;走開,我告訴你,否則我試試是你的腦袋硬還是我的棍子硬:我跟你直說。

passages.title: Oswald 奧斯華
passages.original: Out, dunghill!
passages.vernacular: 滾開,糞堆!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 滾開,糞堆!

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: Chill pick your teeth, zir. Come!
passages.vernacular: 我嚟挑你嘅牙,先生。嚟!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我來挑你的牙,先生。來!

passages.original: No matter vor your foins.
passages.vernacular: 你嘅刺擊冇用。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你的刺擊沒用。

passages.original: [They fight, and Edgar knocks him down.]
passages.vernacular: [二人搏鬥,愛德伽把佢打倒。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [二人搏鬥,愛德伽把他打倒。]

passages.title: Oswald 奧斯華
passages.original: Slave, thou hast slain me.
passages.vernacular: 奴才,你殺咗我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 奴才,你殺了我。

passages.original: Villain, take my purse.
passages.vernacular: 惡棍,攞我嘅錢袋。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 惡棍,拿我的錢袋。

passages.original: If ever thou wilt thrive, bury my body; And give the letters which thou find’st about me To Edmund, Earl of Gloucester.
passages.vernacular: 如果你仲想興旺,埋葬我嘅身體;並把你喺我身上發現嘅信交畀愛德蒙,葛羅斯特伯爵。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果你還想興旺,埋葬我的身體;並把你在我身上發現的信交給愛德蒙,葛羅斯特伯爵。

passages.original: Seek him out Upon the British party.
passages.vernacular: 到不列顛軍隊嗰邊去找佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 到不列顛軍隊那邊去找他。

passages.original: O, untimely death!
passages.vernacular: 啊,不合時宜嘅死!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,不合時宜的死!

passages.original: [Dies.]

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: I know thee well.
passages.vernacular: 我好了解你。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我很了解你。

passages.original: A serviceable villain, As duteous to the vices of thy mistress As badness would desire.
passages.vernacular: 一個稱職嘅惡棍,對你女主人嘅惡行像邪惡所能要求嘅咁盡責。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 一個稱職的惡棍,對你女主人的惡行像邪惡所能要求的那麼盡責。

passages.title: Gloucester 葛羅斯特
passages.original: What, is he dead?
passages.vernacular: 乜嘢,佢死喇?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼,他死了?

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: Sit you down, father; rest you.
passages.vernacular: 坐下,父親;休息。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 坐下,父親;休息。

passages.original: Let’s see these pockets; the letters that he speaks of May be my friends.
passages.vernacular: 讓我哋睇睇呢啲口袋;佢講嘅信或者係我嘅朋友。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 讓我們看看這些口袋;他說的信也許是我的朋友。

passages.original: He’s dead; I am only sorry He had no other deathsman.
passages.vernacular: 佢死喇;我只遺憾佢冇別嘅劊子手。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他死了;我只遺憾他沒有別的劊子手。

passages.original: Let us see: Leave, gentle wax; and, manners, blame us not.
passages.vernacular: 讓我哋睇:蠟啊,請讓開;禮貌,別責怪我哋。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 讓我們看:蠟啊,請讓開;禮貌,別責怪我們。

passages.original: To know our enemies’ minds, we rip their hearts, Their papers is more lawful. [Reads.]
passages.vernacular: 為了解敵人嘅心思,我哋剖開佢哋嘅胸膛,佢哋嘅文件更合法。[讀。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: 為了解敵人的心思,我們剖開他們的胸膛,他們的文件更合法。[讀。]

passages.original: ‘Let our reciprocal vows be remembered.
passages.vernacular: 「讓我哋互相嘅誓言被記住。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 「讓我們互相的誓言被記住。

passages.original: You have many opportunities to cut him off: if your will want not, time and place will be fruitfully offered.
passages.vernacular: 你有許多機會除掉佢:如果你意願不缺,時間同地點會豐富地提供。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你有許多機會除掉他:如果你意願不缺,時間和地點會豐富地提供。

passages.original: There is nothing done if he return the conqueror:
passages.vernacular: 如果佢作為征服者歸嚟,就乜嘢都冇做成:
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果他作為征服者歸來,就什麼都沒做成:

passages.original: then am I the prisoner, and his bed my gaol; from the loathed warmth whereof deliver me, and supply the place for your labour.
passages.vernacular: 嗰時我就係囚犯,佢嘅床就係我嘅牢房;請把我從嗰可憎嘅溫暖中解救出嚟,並頂替佢嘅位置作為你勞績嘅報酬。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那時我就是囚犯,他的床就是我的牢房;請把我從那可憎的溫暖中解救出來,並頂替他的位置作為你勞績的報酬。

passages.original: ‘Your (wife, so I would say) affectionate servant, ‘Goneril.’
passages.vernacular: 你(我本想講妻子)深情嘅僕人,高納麗。」
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你(我本想說妻子)深情的僕人,高納麗。」

passages.original: O indistinguish’d space of woman’s will!
passages.vernacular: 啊,女人意志嘅難以辨別嘅空間!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,女人意志的難以辨別的空間!

passages.original: A plot upon her virtuous husband’s life, And the exchange my brother!
passages.vernacular: 一個謀害佢賢良丈夫性命嘅陰謀,而交換嘅係我弟弟!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 一個謀害她賢良丈夫性命的陰謀,而交換的是我弟弟!

passages.original: Here in the sands Thee I’ll rake up, the post unsanctified Of murderous lechers:
passages.vernacular: 喺呢沙裡我要把你埋起嚟,你呢不神聖嘅、殺人姦夫哋嘅信差:
passages.vernacularMandarin: 在這沙裡我要把你埋起來,你這不神聖的、殺人姦夫們的信差:

passages.original: and in the mature time, With this ungracious paper strike the sight Of the death-practis’d Duke:
passages.vernacular: 到咗成熟嘅時候,用呢封惡劣嘅信刺激嗰被謀殺所圖嘅公爵嘅視線:
passages.vernacularMandarin: 到了成熟的時候,用這封惡劣的信刺激那被謀殺所圖的公爵的視線:

passages.original: for him ’tis well That of thy death and business I can tell.
passages.vernacular: 對佢來講,我能告知你嘅死同你嘅差事,真係好事。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 對他來說,我能告知你的死和你的差事,真是好事。

passages.original: [Exit Edgar, dragging out the body.]
passages.vernacular: [愛德伽拖住屍體下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [愛德伽拖著屍體下。]

passages.title: Gloucester 葛羅斯特
passages.original: The King is mad: how stiff is my vile sense, That I stand up, and have ingenious feeling Of my huge sorrows!
passages.vernacular: 國王瘋喇:我呢卑鄙嘅感官幾咁僵硬,竟仲站住,並對我嘅巨大悲痛有巧妙嘅感受!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 國王瘋了:我這卑鄙的感官多麼僵硬,竟還站著,並對我的巨大悲痛有巧妙的感受!

passages.original: Better I were distract: So should my thoughts be sever’d from my griefs, And woes by wrong imaginations lose The knowledge of themselves.
passages.vernacular: 我若神志錯亂更好:嗰樣我嘅思想會同我嘅悲痛分開,苦難靠錯誤嘅想像失去對自己嘅認識。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我若神志錯亂更好:那樣我的思想會與我的悲痛分開,苦難靠錯誤的想像失去對自己的認識。

passages.original: [A drum afar off.]
passages.vernacular: [遠處鼓聲。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [遠處鼓聲。]

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: Give me your hand.
passages.vernacular: 把手畀我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 把手給我。

passages.original: Far off methinks I hear the beaten drum.
passages.vernacular: 我覺得遠處聽到擊鼓聲。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我覺得遠處聽到擊鼓聲。

passages.original: Come, father, I’ll bestow you with a friend.
passages.vernacular: 嚟,父親,我把你託付畀一位朋友。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 來,父親,我把你託付給一位朋友。

passages.original: [Exeunt.]
passages.vernacular: [同下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [同下。]

chapters.title: Act IV, Scene VII — A Tent in the French Camp 第四幕第七場:法軍營帳

passages.original: Lear on a bed, asleep, soft music playing; Physician, Gentleman and others attending.
passages.vernacular: [李爾瞓喺床上,輕柔音樂奏住;醫生、紳士同其他人侍立。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [李爾睡在床上,輕柔音樂奏著;醫生、紳士和其他人侍立。]

passages.original: Enter Cordelia and Kent.
passages.vernacular: [考黛莉亞同肯特上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [考黛莉亞和肯特上。]

passages.title: Cordelia 考黛莉亞
passages.original: O thou good Kent, how shall I live and work To match thy goodness?
passages.vernacular: 啊你好肯特,我要點樣活住、做事,才能同你嘅善良相配?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊你好肯特,我要怎樣活著、做事,才能與你的善良相配?

passages.original: My life will be too short, And every measure fail me.
passages.vernacular: 我嘅生命太短,一切尺度都唔夠。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我的生命太短,一切尺度都不夠。

passages.title: Kent 肯特
passages.original: To be acknowledg’d, madam, is o’erpaid.
passages.vernacular: 被承認,夫人,已係過度嘅報酬。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 被承認,夫人,已是過度的報酬。

passages.original: All my reports go with the modest truth; Nor more, nor clipp’d, but so.
passages.vernacular: 我嘅一切報告都符合謙遜嘅真相;不多不少,就係咁樣。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我的一切報告都符合謙遜的真相;不多不少,就是這樣。

passages.title: Cordelia 考黛莉亞
passages.original: Be better suited, These weeds are memories of those worser hours: I prythee put them off.
passages.vernacular: 換一身更好嘅衣服,呢啲破衣係嗰啲較壞時辰嘅記憶:請你脫下佢哋。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 換一身更好的衣服,這些破衣是那些較壞時辰的記憶:請你脫下它們。

passages.title: Kent 肯特
passages.original: Pardon, dear madam; Yet to be known shortens my made intent.
passages.vernacular: 原諒,親愛嘅夫人;被認出會縮短我已定嘅意圖。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 原諒,親愛的夫人;被認出會縮短我已定的意圖。

passages.original: My boon I make it that you know me not Till time and I think meet.
passages.vernacular: 我嘅請求係,喺時機同我自己認為合適之前,你唔好認出我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我的請求是,在時機和我自己認為合適之前,你不要認出我。

passages.title: Cordelia 考黛莉亞
passages.original: Then be’t so, my good lord.
passages.vernacular: 嗰就咁樣吧,我嘅好大人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那就這樣吧,我的好大人。

passages.original: [To the Physician.]
passages.vernacular: [對醫生。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [對醫生。]

passages.original: How does the King?
passages.vernacular: 國王點樣?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 國王怎樣?

passages.title: Physician 醫生
passages.original: Madam, sleeps still.
passages.vernacular: 夫人,仍喺瞓。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 夫人,仍在睡。

passages.title: Cordelia 考黛莉亞
passages.original: O you kind gods, Cure this great breach in his abused nature!
passages.vernacular: 啊你哋仁慈嘅諸神,治癒佢被虐待嘅天性中嘅呢個大裂口!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊你們仁慈的諸神,治癒他被虐待的天性中的這個大裂口!

passages.original: The untun’d and jarring senses, O, wind up Of this child-changed father.
passages.vernacular: 啊,畀呢個被細路改變嘅父親嗰失調刺耳嘅感官上好弦吧。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,給這個被孩子改變的父親那失調刺耳的感官上好弦吧。

passages.title: Physician 醫生
passages.original: So please your majesty That we may wake the King: he hath slept long.
passages.vernacular: 請陛下允許我哋叫醒國王:佢瞓咗好久。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 請陛下允許我們叫醒國王:他睡了很久。

passages.title: Cordelia 考黛莉亞
passages.original: Be govern’d by your knowledge, and proceed I’ the sway of your own will.
passages.vernacular: 憑你嘅專業知識行事,按你自己嘅意願進行。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 憑你的專業知識行事,按你自己的意願進行。

passages.original: Is he array’d?
passages.vernacular: 佢穿好衣服咗嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他穿好衣服了嗎?

passages.title: Physician 醫生
passages.original: Ay, madam.
passages.vernacular: 係嘅,夫人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是的,夫人。

passages.original: In the heaviness of sleep We put fresh garments on him.
passages.vernacular: 喺佢沉瞓之時,我哋畀佢換上咗新衣。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 在他沉睡之時,我們給他換上了新衣。

passages.original: Be by, good madam, when we do awake him; I doubt not of his temperance.
passages.vernacular: 我哋叫醒佢時,請夫人喺旁邊;我不懷疑佢嘅平和。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們叫醒他時,請夫人在旁邊;我不懷疑他的平和。

passages.title: Cordelia 考黛莉亞
passages.original: Very well.
passages.vernacular: 好好。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 很好。

passages.title: Physician 醫生
passages.original: Please you draw near.
passages.vernacular: 請靠近些。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 請靠近些。

passages.original: Louder the music there!
passages.vernacular: 音樂放大聲點!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 音樂放大聲點!

passages.title: Cordelia 考黛莉亞
passages.original: O my dear father!
passages.vernacular: 啊我親愛嘅父親!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊我親愛的父親!

passages.original: Restoration hang Thy medicine on my lips; and let this kiss Repair those violent harms that my two sisters Have in thy reverence made!
passages.vernacular: 願恢復把你嘅藥掛喺我嘅嘴唇上;願呢個吻彌補我兩位姊姊喺你尊嚴上造成嘅嗰啲暴烈傷害!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 願恢復把你的藥掛在我的嘴唇上;願這個吻彌補我兩位姊姊在你尊嚴上造成的那些暴烈傷害!

passages.title: Kent 肯特
passages.original: Kind and dear princess!
passages.vernacular: 仁慈親愛嘅公主!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 仁慈親愛的公主!

passages.title: Cordelia 考黛莉亞
passages.original: Had you not been their father, these white flakes Did challenge pity of them.
passages.vernacular: 即使你唔係佢哋嘅父親,呢啲白髮都理應得到佢哋嘅憐憫。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 即使你不是她們的父親,這些白髮也理應得到她們的憐憫。

passages.original: Was this a face To be oppos’d against the warring winds?
passages.vernacular: 呢個係一張該去對抗交戰嘅風嘅臉嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是一張該去對抗交戰的風的臉嗎?

passages.original: To stand against the deep dread-bolted thunder?
passages.vernacular: 該去抵擋深沉可怕嘅雷霆嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 該去抵擋深沉可怕的雷霆嗎?

passages.original: In the most terrible and nimble stroke Of quick cross lightning?
passages.vernacular: 喺最可怕最迅疾嘅交叉閃電一擊中?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 在最可怕最迅疾的交叉閃電一擊中?

passages.original: to watch, poor perdu!
passages.vernacular: 去守夜,可憐嘅哨兵!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 去守夜,可憐的哨兵!

passages.original: With this thin helm?
passages.vernacular: 戴住呢薄薄嘅頭盔?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 戴著這薄薄的頭盔?

passages.original: Mine enemy’s dog, Though he had bit me, should have stood that night Against my fire;
passages.vernacular: 連我敵人嘅狗,即使咬過我,嗰夜都該站喺我火爐前;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 連我敵人的狗,即使咬過我,那夜也該站在我火爐前;

passages.original: and wast thou fain, poor father, To hovel thee with swine and rogues forlorn In short and musty straw?
passages.vernacular: 而你,可憐嘅父親,竟情願同豬同孤苦嘅無賴一起,喺短短發霉嘅稻草中擠進茅屋?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 而你,可憐的父親,竟情願與豬和孤苦的無賴一起,在短短發霉的稻草中擠進茅屋?

passages.original: Alack, alack!
passages.vernacular: 哎呀,哎呀!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎呀,哎呀!

passages.original: ’Tis wonder that thy life and wits at once Had not concluded all.
passages.vernacular: 你嘅生命同神志冇一起了結,真係奇蹟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你的生命和神志沒有一起了結,真是奇蹟。

passages.original: He wakes; speak to him.
passages.vernacular: 佢醒喇;跟佢講話。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他醒了;跟他說話。

passages.title: Physician 醫生
passages.original: Madam, do you; ’tis fittest.
passages.vernacular: 夫人,您講;最合適。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 夫人,您說;最合適。

passages.title: Cordelia 考黛莉亞
passages.original: How does my royal lord?
passages.vernacular: 我嘅王室大人點樣?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我的王室大人怎麼樣?

passages.original: How fares your majesty?
passages.vernacular: 陛下點樣?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 陛下怎樣?

passages.title: Lear 李爾
passages.original: You do me wrong to take me out o’ the grave.
passages.vernacular: 你把我從墳墓裡拉出嚟係錯待我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你把我從墳墓裡拉出來是錯待我。

passages.original: Thou art a soul in bliss; but I am bound Upon a wheel of fire, that mine own tears Do scald like molten lead.
passages.vernacular: 你係喺福樂中嘅靈魂;而我被綁喺一個火輪上,我自己嘅眼淚像熔化嘅鉛一樣燙傷我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你是在福樂中的靈魂;而我被綁在一個火輪上,我自己的眼淚像熔化的鉛一樣燙傷我。

passages.title: Cordelia 考黛莉亞
passages.original: Sir, do you know me?
passages.vernacular: 先生,你認得我嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 先生,你認得我嗎?

passages.title: Lear 李爾
passages.original: You are a spirit, I know: when did you die?
passages.vernacular: 你係個靈魂,我知道:你乜嘢時候死嘅?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你是個靈魂,我知道:你什麼時候死的?

passages.title: Cordelia 考黛莉亞
passages.original: Still, still, far wide!
passages.vernacular: 定係,定係,差得遠!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 還是,還是,差得遠!

passages.title: Physician 醫生
passages.original: He’s scarce awake: let him alone awhile.
passages.vernacular: 佢幾乎冇醒:讓佢靜一會兒。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他幾乎沒醒:讓他靜一會兒。

passages.title: Lear 李爾
passages.original: Where have I been? Where am I?
passages.vernacular: 我到過邊度?我喺邊度?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我到過哪裡?我在哪裡?

passages.original: Fair daylight?
passages.vernacular: 美好嘅白天?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 美好的白天?

passages.original: I am mightily abus’d.
passages.vernacular: 我被騙得好厲害。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我被騙得很厲害。

passages.original: I should e’en die with pity, To see another thus.
passages.vernacular: 睇到別人咁樣,我簡直會因憐憫而死。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 看到別人這樣,我簡直會因憐憫而死。

passages.original: I know not what to say.
passages.vernacular: 我唔知道講乜嘢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我不知道說什麼。

passages.original: I will not swear these are my hands: let’s see; I feel this pin prick.
passages.vernacular: 我唔敢發誓呢啲係我嘅手:讓我睇睇;我感到呢根針扎。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我不敢發誓這些是我的手:讓我看看;我感到這根針扎。

passages.original: Would I were assur’d Of my condition!
passages.vernacular: 但願我能確定我嘅處境!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但願我能確定我的處境!

passages.title: Cordelia 考黛莉亞
passages.original: O, look upon me, sir, And hold your hands in benediction o’er me.
passages.vernacular: 啊,睇住我,先生,伸出你嘅手為我祝福。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,看著我,先生,伸出你的手為我祝福。

passages.original: No, sir, you must not kneel.
passages.vernacular: 不,先生,您不可跪下。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,先生,您不可跪下。

passages.title: Lear 李爾
passages.original: Pray, do not mock me: I am a very foolish fond old man, Fourscore and upward, not an hour more nor less;
passages.vernacular: 請你,唔好嘲笑我:我係個好愚蠢癡情嘅老人,八十歲以上,不多不少一個鐘頭;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 請你,不要嘲笑我:我是個非常愚蠢癡情的老人,八十歲以上,不多不少一個鐘頭;

passages.original: And to deal plainly, I fear I am not in my perfect mind.
passages.vernacular: 講老實話,我怕我嘅神志不完全正常。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 說老實話,我怕我的神志不完全正常。

passages.original: Methinks I should know you, and know this man;
passages.vernacular: 我覺得我該認識你,都該認識呢個人;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我覺得我該認識你,也該認識這個人;

passages.original: Yet I am doubtful: for I am mainly ignorant What place this is;
passages.vernacular: 然而我疑惑:因為我完全唔知道呢個係乜嘢地方;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 然而我疑惑:因為我完全不知道這是什麼地方;

passages.original: and all the skill I have Remembers not these garments;
passages.vernacular: 我所有嘅知識都記不起呢啲衣服;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我所有的知識都記不起這些衣服;

passages.original: nor I know not Where I did lodge last night.
passages.vernacular: 我都唔知道昨夜喺邊度住宿。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我也不知道昨夜在哪裡住宿。

passages.original: Do not laugh at me; For, as I am a man, I think this lady To be my child Cordelia.
passages.vernacular: 別嘲笑我;因為,既然我係個人,我覺得呢位夫人係我嘅細路考黛莉亞。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 別嘲笑我;因為,既然我是個人,我覺得這位夫人是我的孩子考黛莉亞。

passages.title: Cordelia 考黛莉亞
passages.original: And so I am. I am.
passages.vernacular: 我係嘅。我係。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我是的。我是。

passages.title: Lear 李爾
passages.original: Be your tears wet? Yes, faith.
passages.vernacular: 你嘅眼淚係濕嘅嗎?係嘅,真嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你的眼淚是濕的嗎?是的,真的。

passages.original: I pray weep not: If you have poison for me, I will drink it.
passages.vernacular: 請你別哭:如果你有毒藥畀我,我就飲。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 請你別哭:如果你有毒藥給我,我就喝。

passages.original: I know you do not love me; for your sisters Have, as I do remember, done me wrong.
passages.vernacular: 我知道你不愛我;因為你嘅姊姊哋,據我記得,冤枉過我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我知道你不愛我;因為你的姊姊們,據我記得,冤枉過我。

passages.original: You have some cause, they have not.
passages.vernacular: 你有些理由,佢哋冇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你有些理由,她們沒有。

passages.title: Cordelia 考黛莉亞
passages.original: No cause, no cause.
passages.vernacular: 冇理由,冇理由。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 沒有理由,沒有理由。

passages.title: Lear 李爾
passages.original: Am I in France?
passages.vernacular: 我喺法蘭西嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我在法蘭西嗎?

passages.title: Kent 肯特
passages.original: In your own kingdom, sir.
passages.vernacular: 喺您自己嘅王國裡,先生。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 在您自己的王國裡,先生。

passages.title: Lear 李爾
passages.original: Do not abuse me.
passages.vernacular: 別騙我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 別騙我。

passages.title: Physician 醫生
passages.original: Be comforted, good madam, the great rage, You see, is kill’d in him:
passages.vernacular: 請安心,好夫人,您睇,嗰巨大嘅狂怒已喺佢身上被殺死喇:
passages.vernacularMandarin: 請安心,好夫人,您看,那巨大的狂怒已在他身上被殺死了:

passages.original: and yet it is danger To make him even o’er the time he has lost.
passages.vernacular: 然而讓佢補上失去嘅時間,係危險嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 然而讓他補上失去的時間,是危險的。

passages.original: Desire him to go in; trouble him no more Till further settling.
passages.vernacular: 請佢進去;唔好再打擾佢,直到進一步安定。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 請他進去;不要再打擾他,直到進一步安定。

passages.title: Cordelia 考黛莉亞
passages.original: Will’t please your highness walk?
passages.vernacular: 陛下願意走走嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 陛下願意走走嗎?

passages.title: Lear 李爾
passages.original: You must bear with me: Pray you now, forget and forgive: I am old and foolish.
passages.vernacular: 你必須忍耐我:請你而家忘記並原諒:我老喇,愚蠢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你必須忍耐我:請你現在忘記並原諒:我老了,愚蠢。

passages.original: [Exeunt Lear, Cordelia, Physician and Attendants.]
passages.vernacular: [李爾、考黛莉亞、醫生同侍從哋下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [李爾、考黛莉亞、醫生和侍從們下。]

passages.title: Gentleman 紳士
passages.original: Holds it true, sir, that the Duke of Cornwall was so slain?
passages.vernacular: 先生,康華爾公爵被咁樣殺死係真嘅嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 先生,康華爾公爵被這樣殺死是真的嗎?

passages.title: Kent 肯特
passages.original: Most certain, sir.
passages.vernacular: 確實,先生。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 確實,先生。

passages.title: Gentleman 紳士
passages.original: Who is conductor of his people?
passages.vernacular: 邊個統率佢嘅人?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 誰統率他的人?

passages.title: Kent 肯特
passages.original: As ’tis said, the bastard son of Gloucester.
passages.vernacular: 據講係葛羅斯特嘅私生子。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 據說是葛羅斯特的私生子。

passages.title: Gentleman 紳士
passages.original: They say Edgar, his banished son, is with the Earl of Kent in Germany.
passages.vernacular: 佢哋講佢被放逐嘅兒子愛德伽,同肯特伯爵喺德國。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他們說他被放逐的兒子愛德伽,與肯特伯爵在德國。

passages.title: Kent 肯特
passages.original: Report is changeable.
passages.vernacular: 傳聞多變。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 傳聞多變。

passages.original: ’Tis time to look about; the powers of the kingdom approach apace.
passages.vernacular: 係該四下睇睇嘅時候喇;王國嘅軍隊正迅速逼近。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是該四下看看的時候了;王國的軍隊正迅速逼近。

passages.title: Gentleman 紳士
passages.original: The arbitrement is like to be bloody.
passages.vernacular: 呢場裁決好可能係血腥嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這場裁決很可能是血腥的。

passages.original: Fare you well, sir.
passages.vernacular: 再見,先生。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 再見,先生。

passages.original: [Exit.]

passages.title: Kent 肯特
passages.original: My point and period will be throughly wrought, Or well or ill, as this day’s battle’s fought.
passages.vernacular: 我嘅目標同終點將被徹底完成,或好或壞,視今日嘅戰鬥如何。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我的目標與終點將被徹底完成,或好或壞,視今日的戰鬥如何。

passages.original: [Exit.]

chapters.title: Act V, Scene I — The British Camp near Dover 第五幕第一場:多佛附近的英軍營地

passages.original: Enter, with drum and colours Edmund, Regan, Officers, Soldiers and others.
passages.vernacular: [愛德蒙、里根、軍官、士兵及其他人帶鼓同旗幟上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [愛德蒙、里根、軍官、士兵及其他人帶鼓和旗幟上。]

passages.title: Edmund 愛德蒙
passages.original: Know of the Duke if his last purpose hold, Or whether since he is advis’d by aught To change the course, he’s full of alteration And self-reproving, bring his constant pleasure.
passages.vernacular: 去問公爵佢最後嘅意圖係否依舊,或係自嗰以後佢被乜嘢勸講而改變咗方針,佢充滿變化同自責,把佢確定嘅意願帶嚟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 去問公爵他最後的意圖是否依舊,或是自那以後他被什麼勸說而改變了方針,他充滿變化和自責,把他確定的意願帶來。

passages.original: [To an Officer, who goes out.]
passages.vernacular: [對一名軍官,軍官下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [對一名軍官,軍官下。]

passages.title: Regan 里根
passages.original: Our sister’s man is certainly miscarried.
passages.vernacular: 我姊姊嘅人肯定出咗差錯。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我姊姊的人肯定出了差錯。

passages.title: Edmund 愛德蒙
passages.original: ’Tis to be doubted, madam.
passages.vernacular: 恐怕係,夫人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 恐怕是,夫人。

passages.title: Regan 里根
passages.original: Now, sweet lord, You know the goodness I intend upon you:
passages.vernacular: 而家,親愛嘅大人,你知道我對你嘅善意:
passages.vernacularMandarin: 現在,親愛的大人,你知道我對你的善意:

passages.original: Tell me but truly, but then speak the truth, Do you not love my sister?
passages.vernacular: 只要真實地告訴我,但要講真話,你不愛我姊姊嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 只要真實地告訴我,但要說真話,你不愛我姊姊嗎?

passages.title: Edmund 愛德蒙
passages.original: In honour’d love.
passages.vernacular: 以尊敬嘅愛。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 以尊敬的愛。

passages.title: Regan 里根
passages.original: But have you never found my brother’s way To the forfended place?
passages.vernacular: 但你係否從未找到我姊夫通往禁地嘅路?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但你是否從未找到我姊夫通往禁地的路?

passages.title: Edmund 愛德蒙
passages.original: That thought abuses you.
passages.vernacular: 嗰種想法冤枉咗您。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那種想法冤枉了您。

passages.title: Regan 里根
passages.original: I am doubtful that you have been conjunct And bosom’d with her, as far as we call hers.
passages.vernacular: 我擔心你同佢結合,擁入懷中,直到我哋所稱嘅佢嘅全部。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我擔心你與她結合,擁入懷中,直到我們所稱的她的全部。

passages.title: Edmund 愛德蒙
passages.original: No, by mine honour, madam.
passages.vernacular: 冇,憑我嘅名譽,夫人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 沒有,憑我的名譽,夫人。

passages.title: Regan 里根
passages.original: I never shall endure her, dear my lord, Be not familiar with her.
passages.vernacular: 我永遠無法忍受佢,親愛嘅大人,別同佢親近。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我永遠無法忍受她,親愛的大人,別和她親近。

passages.title: Edmund 愛德蒙
passages.original: Fear not, She and the Duke her husband!
passages.vernacular: 別怕,佢同佢丈夫公爵!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 別怕,她和她丈夫公爵!

passages.original: Enter with drum and colours Albany, Goneril and Soldiers.
passages.vernacular: [奧本尼、高納麗同士兵哋帶鼓同旗幟上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [奧本尼、高納麗和士兵們帶鼓和旗幟上。]

passages.title: Goneril 高納麗
passages.original: [Aside.]
passages.vernacular: [旁白。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [旁白。]

passages.original: I had rather lose the battle than that sister Should loosen him and me.
passages.vernacular: 我寧願輸掉呢場戰鬥,都唔願嗰位姊姊拆散佢同我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我寧願輸掉這場戰鬥,也不願那位姊姊拆散他和我。

passages.title: Albany 奧本尼
passages.original: Our very loving sister, well be-met.
passages.vernacular: 我哋親愛嘅姊姊,好高興遇見你。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們親愛的姊姊,很高興遇見你。

passages.original: Sir, this I heard: the King is come to his daughter, With others whom the rigour of our state Forc’d to cry out.
passages.vernacular: 先生,我聽講:國王嚟到佢女兒嗰度,仲有其他人,佢哋被我哋國家嘅嚴酷逼得喊冤。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 先生,我聽說:國王來到他女兒那裡,還有其他人,他們被我們國家的嚴酷逼得喊冤。

passages.original: Where I could not be honest, I never yet was valiant.
passages.vernacular: 凡我唔能夠誠實之處,我從來不勇敢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 凡我不能誠實之處,我從來不勇敢。

passages.original: For this business, It toucheth us as France invades our land, Not bolds the King, with others whom I fear Most just and heavy causes make oppose.
passages.vernacular: 就呢件事而言,佢同我哋有關,係因為法蘭西入侵我哋嘅土地,而唔係因為佢鼓舞咗國王,以及其他我擔心因極正當而沉重嘅理由而反對我哋嘅人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 就這件事而言,它與我們有關,是因為法蘭西入侵我們的土地,而不是因為它鼓舞了國王,以及其他我擔心因極正當而沉重的理由而反對我們的人。

passages.title: Edmund 愛德蒙
passages.original: Sir, you speak nobly.
passages.vernacular: 先生,您講得高貴。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 先生,您說得高貴。

passages.title: Regan 里根
passages.original: Why is this reason’d?
passages.vernacular: 點解要爭論呢個?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 為什麼要爭論這個?

passages.title: Goneril 高納麗
passages.original: Combine together ’gainst the enemy; For these domestic and particular broils Are not the question here.
passages.vernacular: 聯合起嚟對付敵人;因為呢啲家庭同個人嘅爭吵唔係呢度嘅問題。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 聯合起來對付敵人;因為這些家庭和個人的爭吵不是這裡的問題。

passages.title: Albany 奧本尼
passages.original: Let’s, then, determine with the ancient of war On our proceeding.
passages.vernacular: 咁,讓我哋同老戰將哋商定我哋嘅行動。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那麼,讓我們與老戰將們商定我們的行動。

passages.title: Edmund 愛德蒙
passages.original: I shall attend you presently at your tent.
passages.vernacular: 我即刻到你帳篷聽候。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我馬上到你帳篷聽候。

passages.title: Regan 里根
passages.original: Sister, you’ll go with us?
passages.vernacular: 姊姊,你同我哋一起去嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 姊姊,你和我們一起去嗎?

passages.title: Goneril 高納麗
passages.original: No.
passages.vernacular: 不。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不。

passages.title: Regan 里根
passages.original: ’Tis most convenient; pray you, go with us.
passages.vernacular: 呢最合適;請你同我哋一起去。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這最合適;請你與我們一起去。

passages.title: Goneril 高納麗
passages.original: [Aside.]
passages.vernacular: [旁白。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [旁白。]

passages.original: O, ho, I know the riddle. I will go.
passages.vernacular: 啊,嗬,我知道呢個謎。我去。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,嗬,我知道這個謎。我去。

passages.original: [Exeunt Edmund, Regan, Goneril, Officers, Soldiers and Attendants.]
passages.vernacular: [愛德蒙、里根、高納麗、軍官、士兵同侍從哋下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [愛德蒙、里根、高納麗、軍官、士兵和侍從們下。]

passages.title: Goneril 高納麗
passages.original: As they are going out, enter Edgar disguised.
passages.vernacular: 當佢哋出去時,喬裝嘅愛德伽上。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 當他們出去時,喬裝的愛德伽上。

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: If e’er your grace had speech with man so poor, Hear me one word.
passages.vernacular: 如果殿下曾同如此貧窮嘅人講過話,請聽我一句。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果殿下曾與如此貧窮的人說過話,請聽我一句。

passages.title: Albany 奧本尼
passages.original: I’ll overtake you. Speak.
passages.vernacular: 我會趕上你哋。講。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我會趕上你們。說。

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: Before you fight the battle, ope this letter.
passages.vernacular: 喺你打呢場仗之前,打開呢封信。
