passages.vernacularMandarin: 在你打這場仗之前,打開這封信。

passages.original: If you have victory, let the trumpet sound For him that brought it:
passages.vernacular: 如果你得勝,讓號角為送信嘅人吹響:
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果你得勝,讓號角為送信的人吹響:

passages.original: wretched though I seem, I can produce a champion that will prove What is avouched there.
passages.vernacular: 雖然我睇起嚟可憐,我能找出一位勇士,證明嗰度所宣稱嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 雖然我看起來可憐,我能找出一位勇士,證明那裡所宣稱的。

passages.original: If you miscarry, Your business of the world hath so an end, And machination ceases.
passages.vernacular: 如果你失敗,你在世上嘅事業就此終結,陰謀都停止。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果你失敗,你在世上的事業就此終結,陰謀也停止。

passages.original: Fortune love you!
passages.vernacular: 願命運愛你!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 願命運愛你!

passages.title: Albany 奧本尼
passages.original: Stay till I have read the letter.
passages.vernacular: 等我讀咗信。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 等我讀了信。

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: I was forbid it.
passages.vernacular: 我被禁止咁樣。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我被禁止這樣。

passages.original: When time shall serve, let but the herald cry, And I’ll appear again.
passages.vernacular: 時機到時,只要傳令官一喊,我就再出現。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 時機到時,只要傳令官一喊,我就再出現。

passages.title: Albany 奧本尼
passages.original: Why, fare thee well.
passages.vernacular: 好,再見。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好,再見。

passages.original: I will o’erlook thy paper.
passages.vernacular: 我會瀏覽你嘅紙。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我會瀏覽你的紙。

passages.original: [Exit Edgar.]
passages.vernacular: [愛德伽下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [愛德伽下。]

passages.original: Enter Edmund.
passages.vernacular: [愛德蒙上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [愛德蒙上。]

passages.title: Edmund 愛德蒙
passages.original: The enemy’s in view; draw up your powers.
passages.vernacular: 敵人已喺視野中;整頓你嘅軍隊。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 敵人已在視野中;整頓你的軍隊。

passages.original: Here is the guess of their true strength and forces By diligent discovery;
passages.vernacular: 呢度係對佢哋真實實力同兵力嘅估計,係仔細偵察得嚟嘅;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這裡是對他們真實實力和兵力的估計,是仔細偵察得來的;

passages.original: but your haste Is now urg’d on you.
passages.vernacular: 但您而家被催促得緊急。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但您現在被催促得緊急。

passages.title: Albany 奧本尼
passages.original: We will greet the time.
passages.vernacular: 我哋將迎接呢陣刻。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們將迎接這時刻。

passages.original: [Exit.]

passages.title: Edmund 愛德蒙
passages.original: To both these sisters have I sworn my love; Each jealous of the other, as the stung Are of the adder.
passages.vernacular: 我對呢兩位姊妹都發過愛嘅誓言;彼此嫉妒,如同被毒蛇咬過嘅人嫉妒毒蛇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我對這兩位姊妹都發過愛的誓言;彼此嫉妒,如同被毒蛇咬過的人嫉妒毒蛇。

passages.original: Which of them shall I take? Both? One? Or neither?
passages.vernacular: 我該娶邊個?兩個?一個?定係都不?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我該娶哪個?兩個?一個?還是都不?

passages.original: Neither can be enjoy’d, If both remain alive.
passages.vernacular: 如果兩人都活住,邊個都享受不喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果兩人都活著,哪個都享受不了。

passages.original: To take the widow Exasperates, makes mad her sister Goneril;
passages.vernacular: 娶寡婦會激怒、逼瘋佢姊姊高納麗;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 娶寡婦會激怒、逼瘋她姊姊高納麗;

passages.original: And hardly shall I carry out my side, Her husband being alive.
passages.vernacular: 而且佢丈夫活住,我好難執行我呢一方嘅計劃。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 而且她丈夫活著,我很難執行我這一方的計劃。

passages.original: Now, then, we’ll use His countenance for the battle;
passages.vernacular: 而家,咁,我哋利用佢嘅名義進行呢場戰鬥;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 現在,那麼,我們利用他的名義進行這場戰鬥;

passages.original: which being done, Let her who would be rid of him devise His speedy taking off.
passages.vernacular: 完成後,讓想擺脫佢嘅人設法迅速除掉佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 完成後,讓想擺脫他的人設法迅速除掉他。

passages.original: As for the mercy Which he intends to Lear and to Cordelia, The battle done, and they within our power, Shall never see his pardon:
passages.vernacular: 至於佢打算對李爾同考黛莉亞施予嘅憐憫,戰鬥結束後,佢哋落入我哋掌握,絕唔會睇到佢嘅赦免:
passages.vernacularMandarin: 至於他打算對李爾和考黛莉亞施予的憐憫,戰鬥結束後,他們落入我們掌握,絕不會看到他的赦免:

passages.original: for my state Stands on me to defend, not to debate.
passages.vernacular: 因為我嘅地位要我去保衛,而唔係去爭論。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 因為我的地位要我去保衛,而不是去爭論。

passages.original: [Exit.]

chapters.title: Act V, Scene II — A Field between the Two Camps 第五幕第二場:兩軍營地之間的田野

passages.original: Alarum within. Enter with drum and colours, Lear, Cordelia and their Forces, and exeunt.
passages.vernacular: [內有警報聲。李爾、考黛莉亞及其軍隊帶鼓同旗幟上,然後下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [內有警報聲。李爾、考黛莉亞及其軍隊帶鼓和旗幟上,然後下。]

passages.original: Enter Edgar and Gloucester.
passages.vernacular: [愛德伽同葛羅斯特上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [愛德伽和葛羅斯特上。]

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: Here, father, take the shadow of this tree For your good host;
passages.vernacular: 喺呢度,父親,把呢棵樹嘅影子當您嘅好主人;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 在這裡,父親,把這棵樹的影子當您的好主人;

passages.original: pray that the right may thrive: If ever I return to you again, I’ll bring you comfort.
passages.vernacular: 祈禱正義得勝:如果我仲能回到你呢度,我會帶嚟安慰。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 祈禱正義得勝:如果我還能回到你這裡,我會帶來安慰。

passages.title: Gloucester 葛羅斯特
passages.original: Grace go with you, sir!
passages.vernacular: 願恩典同你同喺,先生!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 願恩典與你同在,先生!

passages.original: [Exit Edgar.]
passages.vernacular: [愛德伽下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [愛德伽下。]

passages.original: Alarum and retreat within. Enter Edgar.
passages.vernacular: [內有警報及撤退聲。愛德伽上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [內有警報及撤退聲。愛德伽上。]

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: Away, old man, give me thy hand, away!
passages.vernacular: 走,老人,把手畀我,走!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 走,老人,把手給我,走!

passages.original: King Lear hath lost, he and his daughter ta’en:
passages.vernacular: 李爾王輸喇,佢同佢女兒被俘:
passages.vernacularMandarin: 李爾王輸了,他和他女兒被俘:

passages.original: Give me thy hand; come on!
passages.vernacular: 把手畀我;嚟!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 把手給我;來!

passages.title: Gloucester 葛羅斯特
passages.original: No further, sir; a man may rot even here.
passages.vernacular: 唔好再走喇,先生;人喺呢度都可以腐爛。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不要再走了,先生;人在這裡也可以腐爛。

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: What, in ill thoughts again?
passages.vernacular: 乜嘢,又有不好嘅念頭喇?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼,又有不好的念頭了?

passages.original: Men must endure Their going hence, even as their coming hither; Ripeness is all. Come on.
passages.vernacular: 人必須忍受離去,正如忍受嚟到;成熟就係一切。嚟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 人必須忍受離去,正如忍受來到;成熟就是一切。來。

passages.title: Gloucester 葛羅斯特
passages.original: And that’s true too.
passages.vernacular: 呢都係真嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這也是真的。

passages.original: [Exeunt.]
passages.vernacular: [同下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [同下。]

chapters.title: Act V, Scene III — The British Camp near Dover 第五幕第三場:多佛附近的英軍營地

passages.original: Enter in conquest with drum and colours, Edmund, Lear and Cordelia as prisoners; Officers, Soldiers, &c.
passages.vernacular: [勝利進場,帶鼓同旗幟:愛德蒙,李爾同考黛莉亞作為俘虜;軍官、士兵等。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [勝利進場,帶鼓和旗幟:愛德蒙,李爾和考黛莉亞作為俘虜;軍官、士兵等。]

passages.title: Edmund 愛德蒙
passages.original: Some officers take them away: good guard Until their greater pleasures first be known That are to censure them.
passages.vernacular: 有些軍官把佢哋帶走:好好睇守,直到嗰啲要裁決佢哋嘅人嘅更大意旨被知道。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 有些軍官把他們帶走:好好看守,直到那些要裁決他們的人的更大意旨被知道。

passages.title: Cordelia 考黛莉亞
passages.original: We are not the first Who with best meaning have incurr’d the worst.
passages.vernacular: 我哋唔係第一批抱住最好嘅用意卻招致最壞下場嘅人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們不是第一批抱著最好的用意卻招致最壞下場的人。

passages.original: For thee, oppressed King, I am cast down; Myself could else out-frown false fortune’s frown.
passages.vernacular: 為了你,被壓迫嘅國王,我才沮喪;否則我自己能以怒容壓倒虛假命運嘅怒容。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 為了你,被壓迫的國王,我才沮喪;否則我自己能以怒容壓倒虛假命運的怒容。

passages.original: Shall we not see these daughters and these sisters?
passages.vernacular: 我哋不去見呢啲女兒同呢啲姊姊嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們不去見這些女兒和這些姊姊嗎?

passages.title: Lear 李爾
passages.original: No, no, no, no.
passages.vernacular: 不,不,不,不。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,不,不,不。

passages.original: Come, let’s away to prison: We two alone will sing like birds i’ the cage:
passages.vernacular: 嚟,我哋去監獄:我哋兩個獨處,像籠中嘅鳥一樣歌唱:
passages.vernacularMandarin: 來,我們去監獄:我們兩個獨處,像籠中的鳥一樣歌唱:

passages.original: When thou dost ask me blessing I’ll kneel down And ask of thee forgiveness.
passages.vernacular: 當你向我求祝福時,我就跪下向你求寬恕。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 當你向我求祝福時,我就跪下向你求寬恕。

passages.original: So we’ll live, And pray, and sing, and tell old tales, and laugh At gilded butterflies, and hear poor rogues Talk of court news;
passages.vernacular: 咁樣我哋活住,祈禱、歌唱、講古老嘅故事、嘲笑鍍金嘅蝴蝶,聽可憐嘅無賴談論宮廷新聞;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這樣我們活著,祈禱、歌唱、講古老的故事、嘲笑鍍金的蝴蝶,聽可憐的無賴談論宮廷新聞;

passages.original: and we’ll talk with them too, Who loses and who wins;
passages.vernacular: 我哋都同佢哋談論,邊個輸邊個贏;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們也和他們談論,誰輸誰贏;

passages.original: who’s in, who’s out; And take upon’s the mystery of things, As if we were God’s spies.
passages.vernacular: 邊個在位,邊個下台;並承擔萬事奧祕嘅使命,彷彿我哋係上帝嘅探子。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 誰在位,誰下台;並承擔萬事奧祕的使命,彷彿我們是上帝的探子。

passages.original: And we’ll wear out, In a wall’d prison, packs and sects of great ones That ebb and flow by the moon.
passages.vernacular: 我哋將喺圍牆裡嘅監獄中,睇盡嗰一群群、一派派隨月亮漲落嘅大人物。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們將在圍牆裡的監獄中,看盡那一群群、一派派隨月亮漲落的大人物。

passages.title: Edmund 愛德蒙
passages.original: Take them away.
passages.vernacular: 帶走佢哋。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 帶走他們。

passages.title: Lear 李爾
passages.original: Upon such sacrifices, my Cordelia, The gods themselves throw incense.
passages.vernacular: 對咁樣嘅祭品,我嘅考黛莉亞,諸神自己都投下香料。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 對這樣的祭品,我的考黛莉亞,諸神自己也投下香料。

passages.original: Have I caught thee?
passages.vernacular: 我抓到你咗嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我抓到你了嗎?

passages.original: He that parts us shall bring a brand from heaven, And fire us hence like foxes.
passages.vernacular: 邊個要拆散我哋,就得從天上帶嚟火把,像驅趕狐狸嗰樣用火把我哋趕出去。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 誰要拆散我們,就得從天上帶來火把,像驅趕狐狸那樣用火把我們趕出去。

passages.original: Wipe thine eyes; The good years shall devour them, flesh and fell, Ere they shall make us weep!
passages.vernacular: 擦乾你嘅眼睛;好年月會把佢哋吞噬,連肉帶皮,才會使我哋哭!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 擦乾你的眼睛;好年月會把他們吞噬,連肉帶皮,才會使我們哭!

passages.original: We’ll see ’em starve first: come.
passages.vernacular: 我哋要先睇佢哋餓死:嚟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們要先看他們餓死:來。

passages.original: [Exeunt Lear and Cordelia, guarded.]
passages.vernacular: [李爾同考黛莉亞喺押解下下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [李爾和考黛莉亞在押解下下。]

passages.title: Edmund 愛德蒙
passages.original: Come hither, captain, hark.
passages.vernacular: 過嚟,隊長,聽住。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 過來,隊長,聽著。

passages.original: Take thou this note [giving a paper]; go follow them to prison.
passages.vernacular: 攞呢張字條[遞上一張紙];跟住佢哋去監獄。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 拿這張字條[遞上一張紙];跟著他們去監獄。

passages.original: One step I have advanc’d thee; if thou dost As this instructs thee, thou dost make thy way To noble fortunes:
passages.vernacular: 我已提拔你一步;如果你照呢個指示做,你就為自己開出通往高貴前程嘅路:
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我已提拔你一步;如果你照這個指示做,你就為自己開出通往高貴前程的路:

passages.original: know thou this, that men Are as the time is; to be tender-minded Does not become a sword.
passages.vernacular: 要知道,人隨時勢而定;心腸柔軟不適合配劍。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 要知道,人隨時勢而定;心腸柔軟不適合配劍。

passages.original: Thy great employment Will not bear question; either say thou’lt do’t, Or thrive by other means.
passages.vernacular: 你嘅重大任務唔容質疑;你要麼講你會做,要麼用別嘅方式謀發達。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你的重大任務不容質疑;你要麼說你會做,要麼用別的方式謀發達。

passages.title: Captain 隊長
passages.original: I’ll do’t, my lord.
passages.vernacular: 我會做,大人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我會做,大人。

passages.title: Edmund 愛德蒙
passages.original: About it; and write happy when thou hast done.
passages.vernacular: 去辦;完成後寫上「大吉」。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 去辦;完成後寫上「大吉」。

passages.original: Mark, I say, instantly; and carry it so As I have set it down.
passages.vernacular: 注意,我講即刻;並照我寫下嘅嗰樣辦。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 注意,我說立刻;並照我寫下的那樣辦。

passages.title: Captain 隊長
passages.original: I cannot draw a cart, nor eat dried oats; If it be man’s work, I’ll do’t.
passages.vernacular: 我唔能夠拉車,都唔能夠食乾燕麥;如果係男人嘅活,我嚟做。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我不能拉車,也不能吃乾燕麥;如果是男人的活,我來做。

passages.original: [Exit.]
Flourish. Enter Albany, Goneril, Regan, Officers and Attendants.
passages.vernacular: [號角齊鳴。奧本尼、高納麗、里根、軍官同侍從哋上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [號角齊鳴。奧本尼、高納麗、里根、軍官和侍從們上。]

passages.title: Albany 奧本尼
passages.original: Sir, you have show’d today your valiant strain, And fortune led you well:
passages.vernacular: 先生,您今日顯示咗您嘅英勇血統,命運都引導您順利:
passages.vernacularMandarin: 先生,您今天顯示了您的英勇血統,命運也引導您順利:

passages.original: you have the captives Who were the opposites of this day’s strife:
passages.vernacular: 您得到咗今日爭鬥中對立方嘅俘虜:
passages.vernacularMandarin: 您得到了今日爭鬥中對立方的俘虜:

passages.original: I do require them of you, so to use them As we shall find their merits and our safety May equally determine.
passages.vernacular: 我要求您把佢哋交畀我,按佢哋嘅功過同我哋嘅安全可以同等決定嘅方式對待佢哋。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我要求您把他們交給我,按他們的功過和我們的安全可以同等決定的方式對待他們。

passages.title: Edmund 愛德蒙
passages.original: Sir, I thought it fit To send the old and miserable King To some retention and appointed guard;
passages.vernacular: 先生,我認為適宜把年老悲慘嘅國王送到某個拘留處同指定嘅睇守下;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 先生,我認為適宜把年老悲慘的國王送到某個拘留處和指定的看守下;

passages.original: Whose age has charms in it, whose title more, To pluck the common bosom on his side, And turn our impress’d lances in our eyes Which do command them.
passages.vernacular: 佢嘅年紀帶有魅力,佢嘅頭銜更甚,足以把普通人嘅心拉到佢嗰邊,並把我哋徵召嘅長矛轉過嚟對準我哋呢啲指揮者嘅眼睛。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他的年紀帶有魅力,他的頭銜更甚,足以把普通人的心拉到他那邊,並把我們徵召的長矛轉過來對準我們這些指揮者的眼睛。

passages.original: With him I sent the queen; My reason all the same;
passages.vernacular: 同佢一起我送走咗王后;我嘅理由一樣;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 同他一起我送走了王后;我的理由一樣;

passages.original: and they are ready Tomorrow, or at further space, to appear Where you shall hold your session.
passages.vernacular: 佢哋聽日或稍後,準備好出而家您開庭嘅地方。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他們明天或稍後,準備好出現在您開庭的地方。

passages.original: At this time We sweat and bleed: the friend hath lost his friend;
passages.vernacular: 此刻我哋流汗流血:朋友失去咗朋友;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 此刻我們流汗流血:朋友失去了朋友;

passages.original: And the best quarrels in the heat are curs’d By those that feel their sharpness.
passages.vernacular: 而最好嘅爭執喺激烈中,會被感受佢哋鋒芒嘅人詛咒。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 而最好的爭執在激烈中,會被感受它們鋒芒的人詛咒。

passages.original: The question of Cordelia and her father Requires a fitter place.
passages.vernacular: 關於考黛莉亞同佢父親嘅問題,需要一個更合適嘅地方。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 關於考黛莉亞和她父親的問題,需要一個更合適的地方。

passages.title: Albany 奧本尼
passages.original: Sir, by your patience, I hold you but a subject of this war, Not as a brother.
passages.vernacular: 先生,請恕我直言,我只把您視為呢場戰爭嘅臣屬,唔係兄弟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 先生,請恕我直言,我只把您視為這場戰爭的臣屬,不是兄弟。

passages.title: Regan 里根
passages.original: That’s as we list to grace him.
passages.vernacular: 嗰要睇我哋願意點樣抬舉佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那要看我們願意怎樣抬舉他。

passages.original: Methinks our pleasure might have been demanded Ere you had spoke so far.
passages.vernacular: 我覺得,喺您講得咁遠之前,本該先問問我哋嘅意願。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我覺得,在您說得這麼遠之前,本該先問問我們的意願。

passages.original: He led our powers; Bore the commission of my place and person;
passages.vernacular: 佢統率我哋嘅軍隊;帶住我嘅職位同人格嘅委任;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他統率我們的軍隊;帶著我的職位和人格的委任;

passages.original: The which immediacy may well stand up And call itself your brother.
passages.vernacular: 呢種直接性完全可以站得住,並稱自己為您嘅兄弟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這種直接性完全可以站得住,並稱自己為您的兄弟。

passages.title: Goneril 高納麗
passages.original: Not so hot: In his own grace he doth exalt himself, More than in your addition.
passages.vernacular: 別咁激動:佢靠自己嘅恩寵抬高自己,勝過靠你嘅頭銜。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 別這麼激動:他靠自己的恩寵抬高自己,勝過靠你的頭銜。

passages.title: Regan 里根
passages.original: In my rights, By me invested, he compeers the best.
passages.vernacular: 喺我嘅權利中,由我授予,佢同最高者平起平坐。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 在我的權利中,由我授予,他與最高者平起平坐。

passages.title: Albany 奧本尼
passages.original: That were the most, if he should husband you.
passages.vernacular: 如果佢做你嘅丈夫,嗰個就係最大嘅喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果他做你的丈夫,那就是最大的了。

passages.title: Regan 里根
passages.original: Jesters do oft prove prophets.
passages.vernacular: 開玩笑嘅人常常成為預言家。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 開玩笑的人常常成為預言家。

passages.title: Goneril 高納麗
passages.original: Holla, holla!
passages.vernacular: 喂,喂!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 喂,喂!

passages.original: That eye that told you so look’d but asquint.
passages.vernacular: 告訴你嗰話嘅眼睛係斜視嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 告訴你那話的眼睛是斜視的。

passages.title: Regan 里根
passages.original: Lady, I am not well; else I should answer From a full-flowing stomach.
passages.vernacular: 夫人,我不舒服;否則我會滿腔怒氣地回答。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 夫人,我不舒服;否則我會滿腔怒氣地回答。

passages.original: General, Take thou my soldiers, prisoners, patrimony;
passages.vernacular: 將軍,攞去我嘅士兵、囚犯、世襲產業;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 將軍,拿去我的士兵、囚犯、世襲產業;

passages.original: Dispose of them, of me; the walls are thine: Witness the world that I create thee here My lord and master.
passages.vernacular: 處置佢哋,處置我;城牆係你嘅:世界為證,我喺此立你為我嘅主人同主君。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 處置他們,處置我;城牆是你的:世界為證,我在此立你為我的主人和主君。

passages.title: Goneril 高納麗
passages.original: Mean you to enjoy him?
passages.vernacular: 你打算享用佢嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你打算享用他嗎?

passages.title: Albany 奧本尼
passages.original: The let-alone lies not in your good will.
passages.vernacular: 允許不允許不喺你嘅善意。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 允許不允許不在你的善意。

passages.title: Edmund 愛德蒙
passages.original: Nor in thine, lord.
passages.vernacular: 都不喺你嘅,大人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 也不在你的,大人。

passages.title: Albany 奧本尼
passages.original: Half-blooded fellow, yes.
passages.vernacular: 半血嘅傢伙,係嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 半血的傢伙,是的。

passages.title: Regan 里根
passages.original: [To Edmund.]
passages.vernacular: [對愛德蒙。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [對愛德蒙。]

passages.original: Let the drum strike, and prove my title thine.
passages.vernacular: 讓鼓敲響,證明我嘅權利就係你嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 讓鼓敲響,證明我的權利就是你的。

passages.title: Albany 奧本尼
passages.original: Stay yet; hear reason: Edmund, I arrest thee On capital treason;
passages.vernacular: 且慢;聽道理:愛德蒙,我以叛國嘅死罪逮捕你;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 且慢;聽道理:愛德蒙,我以叛國的死罪逮捕你;

passages.original: and, in thine arrest, This gilded serpent. [pointing to Goneril.]
passages.vernacular: 喺逮捕你嘅同時,仲有呢條鍍金嘅毒蛇。[指住高納麗。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: 在逮捕你的同時,還有這條鍍金的毒蛇。[指著高納麗。]

passages.original: For your claim, fair sister, I bar it in the interest of my wife;
passages.vernacular: 至於你嘅要求,好妹妹,我為了我妻子嘅利益禁止佢;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 至於你的要求,好妹妹,我為了我妻子的利益禁止它;

passages.original: ’Tis she is sub-contracted to this lord, And I her husband contradict your bans.
passages.vernacular: 佢已同呢位大人訂約,而我作為佢嘅丈夫反對你哋嘅婚約。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她已與這位大人訂約,而我作為她的丈夫反對你們的婚約。

passages.original: If you will marry, make your loves to me, My lady is bespoke.
passages.vernacular: 如果你要結婚,向我求愛吧,我嘅夫人已有人訂喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果你要結婚,向我求愛吧,我的夫人已有人訂了。

passages.title: Goneril 高納麗
passages.original: An interlude!
passages.vernacular: 一段插曲!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 一段插曲!

passages.title: Albany 奧本尼
passages.original: Thou art arm’d, Gloucester.
passages.vernacular: 你全副武裝,葛羅斯特。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你全副武裝,葛羅斯特。

passages.original: Let the trumpet sound: If none appear to prove upon thy person Thy heinous, manifest, and many treasons, There is my pledge.
passages.vernacular: 讓號角吹響:如果冇人出嚟,喺你身上證明你嗰可憎、明顯而眾多嘅叛逆,呢個係我嘅信物。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 讓號角吹響:如果沒有人出來,在你身上證明你那可憎、明顯而眾多的叛逆,這是我的信物。

passages.original: [Throwing down a glove.]
passages.vernacular: [扔下手套。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [扔下手套。]

passages.original: I’ll make it on thy heart, Ere I taste bread, thou art in nothing less Than I have here proclaim’d thee.
passages.vernacular: 我要喺你心上證明,喺我食麵包之前,你喺任何事上都不亞於我喺此宣告你嘅嗰樣壞。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我要在你心上證明,在我吃麵包之前,你在任何事上都不亞於我在此宣告你的那樣壞。

passages.title: Regan 里根
passages.original: Sick, O, sick!
passages.vernacular: 病,啊,病喇!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 病,啊,病了!

passages.title: Goneril 高納麗
passages.original: [Aside.]
passages.vernacular: [旁白。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [旁白。]

passages.original: If not, I’ll ne’er trust medicine.
passages.vernacular: 如果不,我再都不信藥喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果不,我再也不信藥了。

passages.title: Edmund 愛德蒙
passages.original: There’s my exchange.
passages.vernacular: 呢個係我嘅回應。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是我的回應。

passages.original: [Throwing down a glove.]
passages.vernacular: [扔下手套。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [扔下手套。]

passages.original: What in the world he is That names me traitor, villain-like he lies.
passages.vernacular: 不管佢係世上嘅乜嘢人,稱我為叛徒,佢就像惡棍一樣撒謊。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不管他是世上的什麼人,稱我為叛徒,他就像惡棍一樣撒謊。

passages.original: Call by thy trumpet: he that dares approach, On him, on you, who not?
passages.vernacular: 用你嘅號角召喚:敢嚟嘅人,對佢,對你,對邊個都行?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 用你的號角召喚:敢來的人,對他,對你,對誰都行?

passages.original: I will maintain My truth and honour firmly.
passages.vernacular: 我要堅定地維護我嘅真誠同名譽。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我要堅定地維護我的真誠與名譽。

passages.title: Albany 奧本尼
passages.original: A herald, ho!
passages.vernacular: 傳令官,喂!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 傳令官,喂!

passages.original: Enter a Herald.
passages.vernacular: [傳令官上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [傳令官上。]

passages.title: Albany 奧本尼
passages.original: Trust to thy single virtue; for thy soldiers, All levied in my name, have in my name Took their discharge.
passages.vernacular: 信靠你自己單獨嘅美德;至於你嘅士兵,都係以我嘅名義徵召嘅,都已以我嘅名義解散喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 信靠你自己單獨的美德;至於你的士兵,都是以我的名義徵召的,也已以我的名義解散了。

passages.title: Regan 里根
passages.original: My sickness grows upon me.
passages.vernacular: 我嘅病越嚟越重。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我的病越來越重。

passages.title: Albany 奧本尼
passages.original: She is not well.
passages.vernacular: 佢不舒服。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她不舒服。

passages.original: Convey her to my tent.
passages.vernacular: 把佢送到我嘅帳篷。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 把她送到我的帳篷。

passages.original: [Exit Regan, led.]
passages.vernacular: [里根被攙扶下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [里根被攙扶下。]

passages.title: Albany 奧本尼
passages.original: Come hither, herald.
passages.vernacular: 過嚟,傳令官。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 過來,傳令官。

passages.original: Let the trumpet sound And read out this.
passages.vernacular: 讓號角吹響,並宣讀呢個。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 讓號角吹響,並宣讀這個。

passages.title: Officer 軍官
passages.original: Sound, trumpet!
passages.vernacular: 吹吧,號角!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 吹吧,號角!

passages.original: [A trumpet sounds.]
passages.vernacular: [號角響起。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [號角響起。]

passages.title: Herald 傳令官
passages.original: [Reads.]
‘If any man of quality or degree within the lists of the army will maintain upon Edmund, supposed Earl of Gloucester, that he is a manifold traitor, let him appear by the third sound of the trumpet.
passages.vernacular: 「軍中名單內任何有身份、有地位嘅人,若願喺愛德蒙(自稱嘅葛羅斯特伯爵)身上證明佢係多重叛徒,請喺第三聲號角響起時出現。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 「軍中名單內任何有身份、有地位的人,若願在愛德蒙(自稱的葛羅斯特伯爵)身上證明他是多重叛徒,請在第三聲號角響起時出現。

passages.original: He is bold in his defence.’
passages.vernacular: 佢喺自衛上好大膽。」
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他在自衛上很大膽。」

passages.title: Edmund 愛德蒙
passages.original: Sound!
passages.vernacular: 吹!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 吹!

passages.original: [First trumpet.]
passages.vernacular: [第一聲號角。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [第一聲號角。]

passages.title: Herald 傳令官
passages.original: Again!
passages.vernacular: 再吹!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 再吹!

passages.original: [Second trumpet.]
passages.vernacular: [第二聲號角。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [第二聲號角。]

passages.title: Herald 傳令官
passages.original: Again!
passages.vernacular: 再吹!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 再吹!

passages.title: Herald 傳令官
passages.original: Third trumpet.
passages.vernacular: 第三聲號角。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 第三聲號角。

passages.original: Trumpet answers within.
passages.vernacular: 內有號角回應。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 內有號角回應。

passages.original: Enter Edgar, armed, preceded by a trumpet.
passages.vernacular: 愛德伽全副武裝上,前有號角手。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 愛德伽全副武裝上,前有號角手。

passages.title: Albany 奧本尼
passages.original: Ask him his purposes, why he appears Upon this call o’ the trumpet.
passages.vernacular: 問佢嘅目的,點解聽到號角聲就出現。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 問他的目的,為什麼聽到號角聲就出現。

passages.title: Herald 傳令官
passages.original: What are you?
passages.vernacular: 你係邊個?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你是誰?

passages.original: Your name, your quality?
passages.vernacular: 你嘅名字,身份?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你的名字,身份?

passages.original: and why you answer This present summons?
passages.vernacular: 點解回應呢次召喚?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 為什麼回應這次召喚?

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: Know my name is lost; By treason’s tooth bare-gnawn and canker-bit.
passages.vernacular: 要知道我嘅名字已失去;被叛逆之牙啃噬得赤裸,被蛀蟲咬蝕。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 要知道我的名字已失去;被叛逆之牙啃噬得赤裸,被蛀蟲咬蝕。

passages.original: Yet am I noble as the adversary I come to cope.
passages.vernacular: 然而我同我嚟較量嘅對手一樣高貴。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 然而我和我來較量的對手一樣高貴。

passages.title: Albany 奧本尼
passages.original: Which is that adversary?
passages.vernacular: 邊個係嗰對手?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 誰是那對手?

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: What’s he that speaks for Edmund, Earl of Gloucester?
passages.vernacular: 邊個為愛德蒙,葛羅斯特伯爵講話?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 誰為愛德蒙,葛羅斯特伯爵說話?

passages.title: Edmund 愛德蒙
passages.original: Himself, what say’st thou to him?
passages.vernacular: 就係佢本人,你對佢有乜嘢話講?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 就是他本人,你對他有什麼話說?

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: Draw thy sword, That if my speech offend a noble heart, Thy arm may do thee justice: here is mine.
passages.vernacular: 拔出你嘅劍,如果我嘅話冒犯咗高貴嘅心,你嘅手臂可以為你主持公道:呢個係我嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 拔出你的劍,如果我的話冒犯了高貴的心,你的手臂可以為你主持公道:這是我的。

passages.original: Behold, it is the privilege of mine honours, My oath, and my profession:
passages.vernacular: 睇,呢個係我榮譽、我嘅誓言同我嘅職業嘅特權:
passages.vernacularMandarin: 看,這是我榮譽、我的誓言和我的職業的特權:

passages.original: I protest, Maugre thy strength, youth, place, and eminence, Despite thy victor sword and fire-new fortune, Thy valour and thy heart, thou art a traitor;
passages.vernacular: 我宣告,不管你嘅力量、年輕、地位同顯赫,不管你勝利嘅劍同嶄新嘅好運,你嘅勇氣同你嘅心,你係個叛徒;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我宣告,不管你的力量、年輕、地位和顯赫,不管你勝利的劍和嶄新的好運,你的勇氣和你的心,你是個叛徒;

passages.original: False to thy gods, thy brother, and thy father;
passages.vernacular: 對你嘅諸神、你嘅兄弟同你嘅父親虛假;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 對你的諸神、你的兄弟和你的父親虛假;

passages.original: Conspirant ’gainst this high illustrious prince;
passages.vernacular: 同呢位崇高顯赫嘅王子為敵而共謀;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 與這位崇高顯赫的王子為敵而共謀;

passages.original: And, from the extremest upward of thy head To the descent and dust beneath thy foot, A most toad-spotted traitor.
passages.vernacular: 從你頭頂嘅最高處到你腳下嘅塵土,係個最有蟾蜍斑點嘅叛徒。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 從你頭頂的最高處到你腳下的塵土,是個最有蟾蜍斑點的叛徒。

passages.original: Say thou ‘No,’ This sword, this arm, and my best spirits are bent To prove upon thy heart, whereto I speak, Thou liest.
passages.vernacular: 你講「不」,呢劍、呢手臂同我最好嘅精神,決意喺你心上證明,我正對住你嘅心講,你撒謊。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你說「不」,這劍、這手臂和我最好的精神,決意在你心上證明,我正對著你的心說,你撒謊。

passages.title: Edmund 愛德蒙
passages.original: In wisdom I should ask thy name; But since thy outside looks so fair and warlike, And that thy tongue some say of breeding breathes, What safe and nicely I might well delay By rule of knighthood, I disdain and spurn.
passages.vernacular: 按智慧我該問你嘅名字;但既然你嘅外表睇來咁英俊好戰,你嘅舌頭又透出啲教養嘅口氣,我可以按騎士規則安全而謹慎地拖延嘅事,我蔑視並唾棄。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 按智慧我該問你的名字;但既然你的外表看來這麼英俊好戰,你的舌頭又透出一些教養的口氣,我可以按騎士規則安全而謹慎地拖延的事,我蔑視並唾棄。

passages.original: Back do I toss those treasons to thy head, With the hell-hated lie o’erwhelm thy heart;
passages.vernacular: 我把嗰啲叛逆扔回你頭上,用地獄都憎恨嘅謊言壓倒你嘅心;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我把那些叛逆扔回你頭上,用地獄也憎恨的謊言壓倒你的心;

passages.original: Which for they yet glance by and scarcely bruise, This sword of mine shall give them instant way, Where they shall rest for ever.
passages.vernacular: 呢啲謊言因為仲只係擦過而幾乎冇傷到,我呢把劍會即刻畀佢哋開路,讓佢哋喺嗰度永遠安息。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這些謊言因為還只是擦過而幾乎沒有傷到,我這把劍會立刻給它們開路,讓它們在那裡永遠安息。

passages.original: Trumpets, speak!
passages.vernacular: 號角,講話!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 號角,說話!

passages.original: [Alarums. They fight. Edmund falls.]
passages.vernacular: [警報聲。二人搏鬥。愛德蒙倒下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [警報聲。二人搏鬥。愛德蒙倒下。]

passages.title: Albany 奧本尼
passages.original: Save him, save him!
passages.vernacular: 救佢,救佢!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 救他,救他!

passages.title: Goneril 高納麗
passages.original: This is mere practice, Gloucester: By the law of arms thou wast not bound to answer An unknown opposite;
passages.vernacular: 呢純粹係詭計,葛羅斯特:按武器嘅法律你冇義務回應一個唔知名嘅對手;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這純粹是詭計,葛羅斯特:按武器的法律你沒有義務回應一個不知名的對手;

passages.original: thou art not vanquish’d, But cozen’d and beguil’d.
passages.vernacular: 你唔係被打敗,而係被騙咗、被迷惑喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你不是被打敗,而是被騙了、被迷惑了。

passages.title: Albany 奧本尼
passages.original: Shut your mouth, dame, Or with this paper shall I stop it.
passages.vernacular: 閉上你嘅嘴,夫人,否則我用呢張紙堵住佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 閉上你的嘴,夫人,否則我用這張紙堵住它。

passages.original: Hold, sir; Thou worse than any name, read thine own evil.
passages.vernacular: 住手,先生;你呢比任何名字都更壞嘅人,讀讀你自己嘅惡行。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 住手,先生;你這比任何名字都更壞的人,讀讀你自己的惡行。

passages.original: No tearing, lady; I perceive you know it.
passages.vernacular: 唔好撕,夫人;我睇出你知道。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不要撕,夫人;我看出你知道。

passages.original: [Gives the letter to Edmund.]
passages.vernacular: [把信交畀愛德蒙。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [把信交給愛德蒙。]

passages.title: Goneril 高納麗
passages.original: Say if I do, the laws are mine, not thine: Who can arraign me for’t?
passages.vernacular: 就算我知道,法律係我嘅,唔係你嘅:邊個能為此審判我?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 就算我知道,法律是我的,不是你的:誰能為此審判我?

passages.original: [Exit.]

passages.title: Albany 奧本尼
passages.original: Most monstrous! O!
passages.vernacular: 最荒唐!啊!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 最荒唐!啊!

passages.original: Know’st thou this paper?
passages.vernacular: 你認得呢張紙嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你認得這張紙嗎?

passages.title: Edmund 愛德蒙
passages.original: Ask me not what I know.
passages.vernacular: 別問我知道乜嘢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 別問我知道什麼。

passages.title: Albany 奧本尼
passages.original: [To an Officer, who goes out.]
passages.vernacular: [對一名軍官,軍官下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [對一名軍官,軍官下。]

passages.original: Go after her; she’s desperate; govern her.
passages.vernacular: 跟住佢去;佢絕望喇;管住佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 跟著她去;她絕望了;管住她。

passages.title: Edmund 愛德蒙
passages.original: What you have charg’d me with, that have I done;
passages.vernacular: 你控告我嘅,我都做喇;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你控告我的,我都做了;

passages.original: And more, much more; the time will bring it out.
passages.vernacular: 仲有更多,多得多;時間會把佢揭示出嚟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 還有更多,多得多;時間會把它揭示出來。

passages.original: ’Tis past, and so am I.
passages.vernacular: 過去喇,我都一樣。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 過去了,我也一樣。

passages.original: But what art thou That hast this fortune on me?
passages.vernacular: 但你係乜嘢人,竟畀我咁樣嘅命運?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但你是什麼人,竟給我這樣的命運?

passages.original: If thou’rt noble, I do forgive thee.
passages.vernacular: 如果你高貴,我原諒你。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果你高貴,我原諒你。

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: Let’s exchange charity.
passages.vernacular: 讓我哋互相寬恕。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 讓我們互相寬恕。

passages.original: I am no less in blood than thou art, Edmund; If more, the more thou hast wrong’d me.
passages.vernacular: 我嘅血統不亞於你,愛德蒙;如果更高,你冤枉我就更甚。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我的血統不亞於你,愛德蒙;如果更高,你冤枉我就更甚。

passages.original: My name is Edgar and thy father’s son.
passages.vernacular: 我嘅名字係愛德伽,係你父親嘅兒子。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我的名字是愛德伽,是你父親的兒子。

passages.original: The gods are just, and of our pleasant vices Make instruments to plague us:
passages.vernacular: 諸神係公正嘅,把我哋歡愉嘅惡行變成折磨我哋嘅工具:
passages.vernacularMandarin: 諸神是公正的,把我們歡愉的惡行變成折磨我們的工具:

passages.original: The dark and vicious place where thee he got Cost him his eyes.
passages.vernacular: 佢喺黑暗邪惡嘅地方生下你,付出咗佢嘅眼睛。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他在黑暗邪惡的地方生下你,付出了他的眼睛。

passages.title: Edmund 愛德蒙
passages.original: Thou hast spoken right, ’tis true; The wheel is come full circle; I am here.
passages.vernacular: 你講得對,呢個係真嘅;輪子已轉完一圈;我喺呢度。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你說得對,這是真的;輪子已轉完一圈;我在這裡。

passages.title: Albany 奧本尼
passages.original: Methought thy very gait did prophesy A royal nobleness.
passages.vernacular: 我覺得你嘅步態就預示一種王者嘅高貴。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我覺得你的步態就預示一種王者的高貴。

passages.original: I must embrace thee.
passages.vernacular: 我必須擁抱你。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我必須擁抱你。

passages.original: Let sorrow split my heart if ever I Did hate thee or thy father.
passages.vernacular: 願悲傷劈開我嘅心,如果我曾恨過你或你父親。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 願悲傷劈開我的心,如果我曾恨過你或你父親。

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: Worthy prince, I know’t.
passages.vernacular: 高貴嘅王子,我知道。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 高貴的王子,我知道。

passages.title: Albany 奧本尼
passages.original: Where have you hid yourself?
passages.vernacular: 你把自己藏喺邊度?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你把自己藏在哪裡?

passages.original: How have you known the miseries of your father?
passages.vernacular: 你係點樣知道你父親嘅苦難嘅?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你是怎樣知道你父親的苦難的?

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: By nursing them, my lord.
passages.vernacular: 靠照料佢哋,大人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 靠照料它們,大人。

passages.original: List a brief tale; And when ’tis told, O that my heart would burst!
passages.vernacular: 聽一個簡短嘅故事;講完後,啊,但願我嘅心爆裂!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 聽一個簡短的故事;說完後,啊,但願我的心爆裂!

passages.original: The bloody proclamation to escape That follow’d me so near,—O, our lives’ sweetness!
passages.vernacular: 嗰血腥嘅通緝令緊緊追住我,為了逃避佢——啊,我哋生命嘅甘甜!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那血腥的通緝令緊緊追著我,為了逃避它——啊,我們生命的甘甜!

passages.original: That with the pain of death we’d hourly die Rather than die at once!—taught me to shift Into a madman’s rags;
passages.vernacular: 我哋寧願每小時承受死嘅痛苦而死去,都不一次死掉!——佢教我換上瘋子嘅破衣;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們寧願每小時承受死的痛苦而死去,也不一次死掉!——它教我換上瘋子的破衣;

passages.original: t’assume a semblance That very dogs disdain’d;
passages.vernacular: 假扮連狗都鄙視嘅模樣;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 假扮連狗都鄙視的模樣;

passages.original: and in this habit Met I my father with his bleeding rings, Their precious stones new lost;
passages.vernacular: 就喺呢身打扮下,我遇見咗我父親,佢流住血嘅眼眶,寶石新近失去;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 就在這身打扮下,我遇見了我父親,他流著血的眼眶,寶石新近失去;

passages.original: became his guide, Led him, begg’d for him, sav’d him from despair;
passages.vernacular: 做咗佢嘅嚮導,領住佢,為佢乞討,救佢脫離絕望;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 做了他的嚮導,領著他,為他乞討,救他脫離絕望;

passages.original: Never,—O fault!—reveal’d myself unto him Until some half hour past, when I was arm’d;
passages.vernacular: 從未——啊過錯!——向佢表明身份,直到約半小時前,當我披上盔甲;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 從未——啊過錯!——向他表明身份,直到約半小時前,當我披上盔甲;

passages.original: Not sure, though hoping of this good success, I ask’d his blessing, and from first to last Told him my pilgrimage.
passages.vernacular: 仲不確定,雖然希望呢個好結果,我請求佢嘅祝福,並從頭到尾告訴佢我嘅朝聖之旅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 還不確定,雖然希望這個好結果,我請求他的祝福,並從頭到尾告訴他我的朝聖之旅。

passages.original: But his flaw’d heart, Alack, too weak the conflict to support!
passages.vernacular: 但佢有裂痕嘅心,哎呀,太弱,支撐不住嗰場衝突!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但他有裂痕的心,哎呀,太弱,支撐不住那場衝突!

passages.original: ’Twixt two extremes of passion, joy and grief, Burst smilingly.
passages.vernacular: 喺激情嘅兩個極端——喜悅同悲痛之間,微笑住爆裂喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 在激情的兩個極端——喜悅與悲痛之間,微笑著爆裂了。

passages.title: Edmund 愛德蒙
passages.original: This speech of yours hath mov’d me, And shall perchance do good, but speak you on;
passages.vernacular: 你呢番話打動咗我,或者會有好處,但請你講下去;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你這番話打動了我,也許會有好處,但請你說下去;

passages.original: You look as you had something more to say.
passages.vernacular: 你睇起嚟仲有話要講。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你看起來還有話要說。

passages.title: Albany 奧本尼
passages.original: If there be more, more woeful, hold it in; For I am almost ready to dissolve, Hearing of this.
passages.vernacular: 如果仲有,更悲慘嘅,就忍住吧;因為聽到呢個,我幾乎要融化喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果還有,更悲慘的,就忍住吧;因為聽到這個,我幾乎要融化了。

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: This would have seem’d a period To such as love not sorrow;
passages.vernacular: 對不愛悲傷嘅人來講,呢本會像係一個句號;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 對不愛悲傷的人來說,這本會像是一個句號;

passages.original: but another, To amplify too much, would make much more, And top extremity.
passages.vernacular: 但另一件事,把悲傷擴大得太多,會多出許多,並超過極限。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但另一件事,把悲傷擴大得太多,會多出許多,並超過極限。

passages.original: Whilst I was big in clamour, came there a man Who, having seen me in my worst estate, Shunn’d my abhorr’d society;
passages.vernacular: 當我正放聲痛哭時,嚟咗一個人,佢曾喺我最糟嘅境況時見過我,躲避我可憎嘅陪伴;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 當我正放聲痛哭時,來了一個人,他曾在我最糟的境況時見過我,躲避我可憎的陪伴;

passages.original: but then finding Who ’twas that so endur’d, with his strong arms He fastened on my neck, and bellow’d out As he’d burst heaven;
passages.vernacular: 但後來發現係邊個咁樣忍受,佢用強壯嘅手臂摟住我嘅脖子,大聲呼號,彷彿要震裂天空;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但後來發現是誰這樣忍受,他用強壯的手臂摟住我的脖子,大聲呼號,彷彿要震裂天空;

passages.original: threw him on my father; Told the most piteous tale of Lear and him That ever ear receiv’d, which in recounting His grief grew puissant, and the strings of life Began to crack.
passages.vernacular: 撲倒喺我父親身上;講述咗李爾同佢最可憐嘅故事,係耳朵聽過最可憐嘅,喺講述中佢嘅悲痛變得強烈,生命嘅弦開始斷裂。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 撲倒在我父親身上;講述了李爾和他最可憐的故事,是耳朵聽過最可憐的,在講述中他的悲痛變得強烈,生命的弦開始斷裂。

passages.original: Twice then the trumpets sounded, And there I left him tranc’d.
passages.vernacular: 嗰時號角響咗兩次,我就把佢留喺昏厥中。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那時號角響了兩次,我就把他留在昏厥中。

passages.title: Albany 奧本尼
passages.original: But who was this?
passages.vernacular: 但呢個係邊個?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但這是誰?

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: Kent, sir, the banish’d Kent; who in disguise Follow’d his enemy king and did him service Improper for a slave.
passages.vernacular: 肯特,先生,被放逐嘅肯特;佢喬裝跟隨佢嘅敵人國王,為佢做咗奴隸都不配嘅服務。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 肯特,先生,被放逐的肯特;他喬裝跟隨他的敵人國王,為他做了奴隸都不配的服務。

passages.original: Enter a Gentleman hastily, with a bloody knife.
passages.vernacular: [一位紳士匆忙上,攞住血刀。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [一位紳士匆忙上,拿著血刀。]

passages.title: Gentleman 紳士
passages.original: Help, help! O, help!
passages.vernacular: 救命,救命!啊,救命!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 救命,救命!啊,救命!

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: What kind of help?
passages.vernacular: 乜嘢樣嘅幫助?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼樣的幫助?

passages.title: Albany 奧本尼
passages.original: Speak, man.
passages.vernacular: 講,人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 說,人。

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: What means this bloody knife?
passages.vernacular: 呢把血刀係乜嘢意思?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這把血刀是什麼意思?

passages.title: Gentleman 紳士
passages.original: ’Tis hot, it smokes; It came even from the heart of—O! she’s dead!
passages.vernacular: 佢係熱嘅,冒住煙;佢剛從——啊!佢死喇!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 它是熱的,冒著煙;它剛從——啊!她死了!

passages.title: Albany 奧本尼
passages.original: Who dead? Speak, man.
passages.vernacular: 邊個死喇?講,人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 誰死了?說,人。

passages.title: Gentleman 紳士
passages.original: Your lady, sir, your lady; and her sister By her is poisoned; she hath confesses it.
passages.vernacular: 您嘅夫人,先生,您嘅夫人;佢妹妹被佢毒死喇;佢已招認。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 您的夫人,先生,您的夫人;她妹妹被她毒死了;她已招認。

passages.title: Edmund 愛德蒙
passages.original: I was contracted to them both, all three Now marry in an instant.
passages.vernacular: 我同佢哋兩個都訂咗婚,三個人而家一瞬間結婚喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我與她們兩個都訂了婚,三個人現在一瞬間結婚了。

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: Here comes Kent.
passages.vernacular: 肯特嚟喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 肯特來了。

passages.original: Enter Kent.
passages.vernacular: [肯特上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [肯特上。]

passages.title: Albany 奧本尼
passages.original: Produce their bodies, be they alive or dead.
passages.vernacular: 把佢哋嘅屍體攞出嚟,無論活死。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 把她們的屍體拿出來,無論活死。

passages.original: This judgement of the heavens that makes us tremble Touches us not with pity.
passages.vernacular: 呢使我哋顫抖嘅諸天嘅審判,並不引起我哋嘅憐憫。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這使我們顫抖的諸天的審判,並不引起我們的憐憫。

passages.original: O, is this he?
passages.vernacular: 啊,呢個係佢嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,這是他嗎?

passages.original: The time will not allow the compliment Which very manners urges.
passages.vernacular: 時間唔容許連禮貌本身所要求嘅客套。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 時間不容許連禮貌本身所要求的客套。

passages.title: Kent 肯特
passages.original: I am come To bid my King and master aye good night: Is he not here?
passages.vernacular: 我嚟係向我嘅國王同主人永遠道晚安:佢不喺呢度嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我來是向我的國王和主人永遠道晚安:他不在這裡嗎?

passages.title: Albany 奧本尼
passages.original: Great thing of us forgot!
passages.vernacular: 我哋忘咗一件大事!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們忘了一件大事!

passages.original: Speak, Edmund, where’s the King?
passages.vernacular: 講,愛德蒙,國王喺邊度?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 說,愛德蒙,國王在哪裡?

passages.original: and where’s Cordelia?
passages.vernacular: 考黛莉亞喺邊度?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 考黛莉亞在哪裡?

passages.title: Albany 奧本尼
passages.original: The bodies of Goneril and Regan are brought in.
passages.vernacular: 高納麗同里根嘅屍體被抬進嚟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 高納麗和里根的屍體被抬進來。

passages.title: Albany 奧本尼
passages.original: Seest thou this object, Kent?
passages.vernacular: 肯特,你睇到呢景象嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 肯特,你看到這景象嗎?

passages.title: Kent 肯特
passages.original: Alack, why thus?
passages.vernacular: 哎呀,點解咁樣?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎呀,為什麼這樣?

passages.title: Edmund 愛德蒙
passages.original: Yet Edmund was belov’d.
passages.vernacular: 然而愛德蒙係被愛嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 然而愛德蒙是被愛的。

passages.original: The one the other poisoned for my sake, And after slew herself.
passages.vernacular: 一個為了我毒死咗另一個,然後自殺。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 一個為了我毒死了另一個,然後自殺。

passages.title: Albany 奧本尼
passages.original: Even so.
passages.vernacular: 正是如此。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 正是如此。

passages.original: Cover their faces.
passages.vernacular: 蓋住佢哋嘅臉。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 蓋住她們的臉。

passages.title: Edmund 愛德蒙
passages.original: I pant for life.
passages.vernacular: 我渴望生命。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我渴望生命。

passages.original: Some good I mean to do, Despite of mine own nature.
passages.vernacular: 我要做些好事,不顧我自己嘅天性。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我要做些好事,不顧我自己的天性。

passages.original: Quickly send, Be brief in it, to the castle; for my writ Is on the life of Lear and on Cordelia; Nay, send in time.
passages.vernacular: 快派人去城堡,要簡短;因為我嘅命令係針對李爾同考黛莉亞嘅生命;不,及時派人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 快派人去城堡,要簡短;因為我的命令是針對李爾和考黛莉亞的生命;不,及時派人。

passages.title: Albany 奧本尼
passages.original: Run, run, O, run!
passages.vernacular: 跑,跑,啊,跑!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 跑,跑,啊,跑!

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: To who, my lord?
passages.vernacular: 去找邊個,大人?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 去找誰,大人?

passages.original: Who has the office?
passages.vernacular: 邊個有呢個職責?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 誰有這個職責?

passages.original: Send Thy token of reprieve.
passages.vernacular: 派你赦免嘅信物去。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 派你赦免的信物去。

passages.title: Edmund 愛德蒙
passages.original: Well thought on: take my sword, Give it the captain.
passages.vernacular: 想得好:攞我嘅劍,交畀隊長。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 想得好:拿我的劍,交給隊長。

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: Haste thee for thy life.
passages.vernacular: 為了你嘅命,趕快。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 為了你的命,趕快。

passages.original: [Exit Edgar.]
passages.vernacular: [愛德伽下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [愛德伽下。]

passages.title: Edmund 愛德蒙
passages.original: He hath commission from thy wife and me To hang Cordelia in the prison, and To lay the blame upon her own despair, That she fordid herself.
passages.vernacular: 佢受你妻子同我嘅委任,要喺監獄裡吊死考黛莉亞,把責任歸咎於佢自己嘅絕望,講佢自殺喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他受你妻子和我的委任,要在監獄裡吊死考黛莉亞,把責任歸咎於她自己的絕望,說她自殺了。

passages.title: Albany 奧本尼
passages.original: The gods defend her!
passages.vernacular: 願諸神保護佢!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 願諸神保護她!

passages.original: Bear him hence awhile.
passages.vernacular: 把佢暫時抬下去。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 把他暫時抬下去。

passages.original: [Edmund is borne off.]
passages.vernacular: [愛德蒙被抬下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [愛德蒙被抬下。]

passages.original: Enter Lear with Cordelia dead in his arms; Edgar, Officer and others following.
passages.vernacular: [李爾抱住死去嘅考黛莉亞上;愛德伽、軍官同其他人跟隨。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [李爾抱著死去的考黛莉亞上;愛德伽、軍官和其他人跟隨。]

passages.title: Lear 李爾
passages.original: Howl, howl, howl, howl!
passages.vernacular: 嚎叫,嚎叫,嚎叫,嚎叫!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 嚎叫,嚎叫,嚎叫,嚎叫!

passages.original: O, you are men of stone.
passages.vernacular: 啊,你哋係石頭做嘅人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,你們是石頭做的人。

passages.original: Had I your tongues and eyes, I’ld use them so That heaven’s vault should crack.
passages.vernacular: 我若有你哋嘅舌頭同眼睛,我會咁樣使用佢哋,讓天穹崩裂。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我若有你們的舌頭和眼睛,我會這樣使用它們,讓天穹崩裂。

passages.original: She’s gone for ever!
passages.vernacular: 佢永遠走喇!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她永遠走了!

passages.original: I know when one is dead, and when one lives; She’s dead as earth.
passages.vernacular: 我知道乜嘢時候人死喇,乜嘢時候活住;佢死得像泥土一樣。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我知道什麼時候人死了,什麼時候活著;她死得像泥土一樣。

passages.original: Lend me a looking glass; If that her breath will mist or stain the stone, Why, then she lives.
passages.vernacular: 借我一面鏡子;如果佢嘅氣息能使佢起霧或沾石,咦,咁佢活住。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 借我一面鏡子;如果她的氣息能使它起霧或沾石,咦,那麼她活著。

passages.title: Kent 肯特
passages.original: Is this the promis’d end?
passages.vernacular: 呢個係預言嘅末日嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是預言的末日嗎?

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: Or image of that horror?
passages.vernacular: 定係嗰恐怖嘅影像?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 還是那恐怖的影像?

passages.title: Albany 奧本尼
passages.original: Fall, and cease!
passages.vernacular: 倒下,終結吧!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 倒下,終結吧!

passages.title: Lear 李爾
passages.original: This feather stirs; she lives!
passages.vernacular: 呢根羽毛動喇;佢活住!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這根羽毛動了;她活著!

passages.original: If it be so, It is a chance which does redeem all sorrows That ever I have felt.
passages.vernacular: 如果係咁樣,呢個係一個能贖回我所感受過嘅一切悲傷嘅機會。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果是這樣,這是一個能贖回我所感受過的一切悲傷的機會。

passages.title: Kent 肯特
passages.original: O, my good master! [Kneeling.]
passages.vernacular: 啊,我嘅好主人![跪下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,我的好主人![跪下。]

passages.title: Lear 李爾
passages.original: Prythee, away!
passages.vernacular: 請你,走開!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 請你,走開!

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: ’Tis noble Kent, your friend.
passages.vernacular: 係高貴嘅肯特,你嘅朋友。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是高貴的肯特,你的朋友。

passages.title: Lear 李爾
passages.original: A plague upon you, murderers, traitors all!
passages.vernacular: 瘟疫降喺你哋身上,謀殺者,全係叛徒!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 瘟疫降在你們身上,謀殺者,全是叛徒!

passages.original: I might have sav’d her; now she’s gone for ever!
passages.vernacular: 我本可救佢;而家佢永遠走喇!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我本可救她;現在她永遠走了!

passages.original: Cordelia, Cordelia!
passages.vernacular: 考黛莉亞,考黛莉亞!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 考黛莉亞,考黛莉亞!

passages.original: stay a little. Ha!
passages.vernacular: 等一等。哈!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 等一等。哈!

passages.original: What is’t thou say’st?
passages.vernacular: 你講乜嘢?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你說什麼?

passages.original: Her voice was ever soft, Gentle, and low, an excellent thing in woman.
passages.vernacular: 佢嘅聲音總是柔和、溫順而低,係女人身上極好嘅嘢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她的聲音總是柔和、溫順而低,是女人身上極好的東西。

passages.original: I kill’d the slave that was a-hanging thee.
passages.vernacular: 我殺咗嗰個吊你嘅奴才。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我殺了那個吊你的奴才。

passages.title: Officer 軍官
passages.original: ’Tis true, my lords, he did.
passages.vernacular: 係真嘅,各位大人,佢殺喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是真的,各位大人,他殺了。

passages.title: Lear 李爾
passages.original: Did I not, fellow?
passages.vernacular: 我唔係殺咗嗎,朋友?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我不是殺了嗎,朋友?

passages.original: I have seen the day, with my good biting falchion I would have made them skip.
passages.vernacular: 我見過嗰樣嘅日子,用我鋒利嘅好彎刀,我能讓佢哋跳起嚟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我見過那樣的日子,用我鋒利的好彎刀,我能讓他們跳起來。

passages.original: I am old now, And these same crosses spoil me.
passages.vernacular: 我而家老喇,呢啲不順把我毀喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我現在老了,這些不順把我毀了。

passages.original: Who are you?
passages.vernacular: 你哋係邊個?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你們是誰?

passages.original: Mine eyes are not o’ the best, I’ll tell you straight.
passages.vernacular: 我嘅眼睛唔係最好嘅,我即刻告訴你。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我的眼睛不是最好的,我馬上告訴你。

passages.title: Kent 肯特
passages.original: If Fortune brag of two she lov’d and hated, One of them we behold.
passages.vernacular: 如果命運誇耀佢愛過同恨過嘅兩個人,其中一個我哋睇到喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果命運誇耀她愛過和恨過的兩個人,其中一個我們看到了。

passages.title: Lear 李爾
passages.original: This is a dull sight.
passages.vernacular: 呢個係個昏暗嘅景象。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是個昏暗的景象。

passages.original: Are you not Kent?
passages.vernacular: 你唔係肯特嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你不是肯特嗎?

passages.title: Kent 肯特
passages.original: The same, Your servant Kent.
passages.vernacular: 正是,你嘅僕人肯特。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 正是,你的僕人肯特。

passages.original: Where is your servant Caius?
passages.vernacular: 你嘅僕人卡尤斯喺邊度?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你的僕人卡尤斯在哪裡?

passages.title: Lear 李爾
passages.original: He’s a good fellow, I can tell you that; He’ll strike, and quickly too:.
passages.vernacular: 佢係個好傢伙,我可以告訴你;佢打人,而且好快。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他是個好傢伙,我可以告訴你;他打人,而且很快。

passages.original: He’s dead and rotten.
passages.vernacular: 佢死喇,腐爛喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他死了,腐爛了。

passages.title: Kent 肯特
passages.original: No, my good lord; I am the very man.
passages.vernacular: 不,我嘅好大人;我就係嗰個人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,我的好大人;我就是那個人。

passages.title: Lear 李爾
passages.original: I’ll see that straight.
passages.vernacular: 我即刻睇睇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我馬上看看。

passages.title: Kent 肯特
passages.original: That from your first of difference and decay Have follow’d your sad steps.
passages.vernacular: 從你起初失勢衰落時,就一路跟隨你悲傷嘅腳步。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 從你起初失勢衰落時,就一路跟隨你悲傷的腳步。

passages.title: Lear 李爾
passages.original: You are welcome hither.
passages.vernacular: 你歡迎嚟到呢度。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你歡迎來到這裡。

passages.title: Kent 肯特
passages.original: Nor no man else.
passages.vernacular: 冇別人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 沒有別人。

passages.original: All’s cheerless, dark and deadly.
passages.vernacular: 一切都冰冷、黑暗、致命。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 一切都冰冷、黑暗、致命。

passages.original: Your eldest daughters have fordone themselves, And desperately are dead.
passages.vernacular: 你嘅大女兒哋已毀滅咗自己,絕望地死喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你的大女兒們已毀滅了自己,絕望地死了。

passages.title: Lear 李爾
passages.original: Ay, so I think.
passages.vernacular: 係,我都咁樣想。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是,我也這樣想。

passages.title: Albany 奧本尼
passages.original: He knows not what he says; and vain is it That we present us to him.
passages.vernacular: 佢唔知道自己喺講乜嘢;我哋喺佢面前出現都係徒勞。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他不知道自己在說什麼;我們在他面前出現也是徒勞。

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: Very bootless.
passages.vernacular: 好徒勞。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 非常徒勞。

passages.original: Enter an Officer.
passages.vernacular: [一名軍官上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [一名軍官上。]

passages.title: Officer 軍官
passages.original: Edmund is dead, my lord.
passages.vernacular: 愛德蒙死喇,大人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 愛德蒙死了,大人。

passages.title: Albany 奧本尼
passages.original: That’s but a trifle here.
passages.vernacular: 喺呢度嗰不過係小事。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 在這裡那不過是小事。

passages.original: You lords and noble friends, know our intent.
passages.vernacular: 各位大人同高貴嘅朋友,知道我哋嘅意圖。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 各位大人和高貴的朋友,知道我們的意圖。

passages.original: What comfort to this great decay may come Shall be applied.
passages.vernacular: 能畀呢巨大衰敗嘅任何安慰都將施予。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 能給這巨大衰敗的任何安慰都將施予。

passages.original: For us, we will resign, During the life of this old majesty, To him our absolute power;
passages.vernacular: 就我哋而言,喺呢位老陛下活住嘅期間,我哋將把絕對權力交畀佢;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 就我們而言,在這位老陛下活著的期間,我們將把絕對權力交給他;

passages.original: [to Edgar and Kent] you to your rights; With boot and such addition as your honours Have more than merited.
passages.vernacular: [對愛德伽同肯特]你哋得到你哋嘅權利;連同你哋嘅榮譽已遠超應得嘅補償同咁樣嘅加封。
passages.vernacularMandarin: [對愛德伽和肯特]你們得到你們的權利;連同你們的榮譽已遠超應得的補償與這樣的加封。

passages.original: All friends shall taste The wages of their virtue and all foes The cup of their deservings.
passages.vernacular: 所有朋友將嘗到佢哋美德嘅報酬,所有敵人將飲到佢哋應得嘅杯。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 所有朋友將嘗到他們美德的報酬,所有敵人將喝到他們應得的杯。

passages.original: O, see, see!
passages.vernacular: 啊,睇,睇!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,看,看!

passages.title: Lear 李爾
passages.original: And my poor fool is hang’d!
passages.vernacular: 我可憐嘅弄臣被吊死喇!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我可憐的弄臣被吊死了!

passages.original: No, no, no life!
passages.vernacular: 不,不,不,冇生命!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,不,不,沒有生命!

passages.original: Why should a dog, a horse, a rat have life, And thou no breath at all?
passages.vernacular: 點解狗、馬、老鼠有生命,而你啲氣息都冇?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 為什麼狗、馬、老鼠有生命,而你一點氣息都沒有?

passages.original: Thou’lt come no more, Never, never, never, never, never!
passages.vernacular: 你唔會再嚟喇,永不,永不,永不,永不,永不!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你不會再來了,永不,永不,永不,永不,永不!

passages.original: Pray you undo this button.
passages.vernacular: 請你解開呢顆鈕扣。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 請你解開這顆鈕扣。

passages.original: Thank you, sir.
passages.vernacular: 謝謝你,先生。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 謝謝你,先生。

passages.original: Do you see this?
passages.vernacular: 你睇見呢個嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你看見這個嗎?

passages.original: Look on her: look, her lips, Look there, look there!
passages.vernacular: 睇佢:睇,佢嘅嘴唇,睇嗰度,睇嗰度!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 看她:看,她的嘴唇,看那裡,看那裡!

passages.original: [He dies.]
passages.vernacular: [佢死。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [他死。]

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: He faints!
passages.vernacular: 佢昏厥喇!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他昏厥了!

passages.original: My lord, my lord!
passages.vernacular: 大人,大人!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 大人,大人!

passages.title: Kent 肯特
passages.original: Break, heart; I prythee break!
passages.vernacular: 碎吧,心;請你碎吧!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 碎吧,心;請你碎吧!

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: Look up, my lord.
passages.vernacular: 抬頭,大人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 抬頭,大人。

passages.title: Kent 肯特
passages.original: Vex not his ghost: O, let him pass!
passages.vernacular: 別攪擾佢嘅靈魂:啊,讓佢走吧!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 別攪擾他的靈魂:啊,讓他走吧!

passages.original: He hates him That would upon the rack of this rough world Stretch him out longer.
passages.vernacular: 邊個要喺呢殘酷世界嘅刑架上把佢拉得更長,邊個就係恨佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 誰要在這殘酷世界的刑架上把他拉得更長,誰就是恨他。

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: He is gone indeed.
passages.vernacular: 佢確實走喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他確實走了。

passages.title: Kent 肯特
passages.original: The wonder is, he hath endur’d so long: He but usurp’d his life.
passages.vernacular: 奇蹟係佢竟忍受咗咁久:佢不過係篡奪咗佢嘅生命。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 奇蹟是他竟忍受了這麼久:他不過是篡奪了他的生命。

passages.title: Albany 奧本尼
passages.original: Bear them from hence.
passages.vernacular: 把佢哋抬走。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 把他們抬走。

passages.original: Our present business Is general woe.
passages.vernacular: 我哋當前嘅事務係全體嘅哀悼。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們當前的事務是全體的哀悼。

passages.original: [To Edgar and Kent.]
passages.vernacular: [對愛德伽同肯特。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [對愛德伽和肯特。]

passages.original: Friends of my soul, you twain, Rule in this realm and the gor’d state sustain.
passages.vernacular: 我心靈嘅朋友,你哋兩位,統治呢個王國,扶持呢創傷累累嘅國家。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我心靈的朋友,你們兩位,統治這個王國,扶持這創傷累累的國家。

passages.title: Kent 肯特
passages.original: I have a journey, sir, shortly to go; My master calls me, I must not say no.
passages.vernacular: 先生,我不久要去旅行;我嘅主人喺召喚,我唔能夠講不。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 先生,我不久要去旅行;我的主人在召喚,我不能說不。

passages.title: Edgar 愛德伽
passages.original: The weight of this sad time we must obey; Speak what we feel, not what we ought to say.
passages.vernacular: 呢悲傷時代嘅重量我哋必須承受;講出我哋感受到嘅,而唔係我哋應當講嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這悲傷時代的重量我們必須承受;說出我們感受到的,而不是我們應當說的。

passages.original: The oldest hath borne most; we that are young Shall never see so much, nor live so long.
passages.vernacular: 最年長嘅承受最多;我哋呢啲年輕嘅,將永遠睇唔到咁多,都活唔到咁久。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 最年長的承受最多;我們這些年輕的,將永遠看不到這麼多,也活不到這麼久。

passages.original: [Exeunt with a dead march.]
passages.vernacular: [奏送葬進行曲,眾人下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [奏送葬進行曲,眾人下。]
